string.ID: In my travels I encountered a people, the slynth, seeking a new home.

strings.string: 我旅途中遇见一群人，名为斯林斯，正在寻找新家园。

string.ID: About the slynth...

strings.string: 说说斯林斯……

string.ID: I see the slynth have arrived. How are they faring?

strings.string: 我看斯林斯已经到了。他们过得如何？

string.ID: It's been a week. Are the slynth settled in?

strings.string: 一周过去了。斯林斯安顿下来了吗？

string.ID: There are no more words for us, wanderer.

strings.string: 我们已无话可说了，旅人。

string.ID: =name=! Live and drink, pilgrim.

strings.string: =name=！且生且饮，朝圣者。

string.ID: =name=! Live and drink, pilgrim.

strings.string: =name=！且生且饮，朝圣者。

string.ID: I have visited the Six Day Stilt.

strings.string: 我去过六日高塔了。

string.ID:
Ah!
Tell me, =player.formalAddressTerm=, was it the picture of wonder as I see it in my mind's eye? Were you beauty-struck by its truths?

strings.string:
啊！
告诉我，=player.formalAddressTerm=，那景象是否如我心中所见，令人惊叹？你可曾为其中真理之美所震撼？

string.ID: Truly breathtaking. How the glass glittered in the sun!

strings.string: 确实令人叹为观止。玻璃在阳光下何等璀璨！

string.ID: To behold the Argent Fathers in simulacra... what revelation!

strings.string: 得见银辉诸父的拟像……何等启示！

string.ID: I saw only empty spectacle. Who can worship a hole in the ground?

strings.string: 我只见空洞的排场。谁会崇拜地上的一个窟窿？

string.ID:
So it's true! O Argent Fathers, how far-reaching your works!
... and my trinket? Did you cast it into the Sacred Well?

strings.string:
果真如此！啊，银辉诸父，你们的作为何其深远！
……那我的小玩意呢？你把它投进圣井了吗？

string.ID: I did.

strings.string: 投了。

string.ID: Sadly, it was lost.

strings.string: 唉，它遗失了。

string.ID: No, I took it apart or sold it or something.

strings.string: 没有，我把它拆了、卖了，或是怎么处理了。

string.ID:
Moon and Sun! The Argent Fathers bless us, our paths are chromed and glistering.
You have my thanks, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Bel shield you.

strings.string:
月与日！银辉诸父赐福于我们，我们的道路镀铬生辉。
=player.formalAddressTerm=，承蒙相助。愿彼勒护佑你。

string.ID: And you as well.

strings.string: 你也一样。

string.ID:
Oh, I am leaden with this knowledge. Yet am I soothed by your pilgrimage.
Moon and Sun, I feel the warmth of the Kasaphescence yet. Praise the Argent Fathers.

strings.string:
唉，得知此事，我心头沉重。然而你的朝圣之行仍抚慰了我。
月与日，圣化现的暖意依然尚存于我心。赞美银辉诸父。

string.ID:
Oh, how your words rasp my soul, =player.formalAddressTerm=. You abrade me.
Let us speak no more.

strings.string:
唉，你的话刺痛我的灵魂，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你磨损了我。
我们不必再谈了。

string.ID: Very well.

strings.string: 好吧。

string.ID:
So you have seen the truth? Great are the machinations of our Argent Fathers!
Our meeting, a tiny Canticle. Fate dances in our shadows by their will and word.
Moon and sun, what a day! What a fine day. Praise Shekhinah!

strings.string:
这么说，你已见证真理？银辉诸父的运筹何其伟大！
你我相会，恰如一篇微小的圣咏。在他们的意志与话语中，命运于我等影间起舞。
月与日，多好的日子！何等美好的一天。赞美舍金纳！

string.ID: Praise Shekhinah!

strings.string: 赞美舍金纳！

string.ID:
Wh-
My heart's sheen wanes to hear this of you. You abrade me, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I am scuffed.
What of my trinket, then? Did you cast it into the... "hole in the ground?"

strings.string:
什——
听你这么说，我心中光彩渐黯。你磨损了我，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我已伤痕斑驳。
那么，我的小玩意呢？你把它投进……“地上的窟窿”了吗？

string.ID: Yes, I threw it in the hole.

strings.string: 是，我把它扔进窟窿里了。

string.ID: No, I lost it.

strings.string: 没有，我弄丢了。

string.ID: I gave it to someone. Or sold it, perhaps.

strings.string: 我把它给了别人。也可能卖掉了。

string.ID:
Well... the light of the Kasaphescence yet glimmers through your rasping edge.
I must, then, thank you.

strings.string:
那么……纵然你的言辞尖刻，圣化现依然透过那锋芒闪烁。
我还是要谢谢你。

string.ID: You're welcome.

strings.string: 不必客气。

string.ID:
My stomach lurches and quavers at the shock of this knowledge.
If there is a lesson in your disregard, I will meditate upon it in my own time.
Let us speak no more.

strings.string:
这消息惊得我胃里翻江倒海。
若你的漠然之中藏着教训，我自会找时间细细思量。
我们不必再谈了。

string.ID: As you say.

strings.string: 依你所言。

string.ID:
Ah, a pit opens under my stomach!
Let us speak no more, I beg you. You scuff me. Live and drink.

strings.string:
啊，我腹中仿佛裂开一个深坑！
求你，别再与我说话。你伤了我的心。且生且饮。

string.ID: Wanderer and =player.formalAddressTerm=! Have you journeyed yet to the Stilt, and seen the Sacred Well?

strings.string: 旅人，=player.formalAddressTerm=！你可曾启程前往高塔，见过圣井？

string.ID: Not yet, friend. Live and drink.

strings.string: 还没有，朋友。且生且饮。

string.ID: Wanderer! Do you venture northwise? Into the Great Desert and nearer the Six Day Stilt?

strings.string: 旅人！你要往北去吗？去大沙漠，离六日高塔更近些？

string.ID: What is the Six Day Stilt?

strings.string: 六日高塔是什么地方？

string.ID: Why do you ask?

strings.string: 你为何这样问？

string.ID:
Ah! The great Mechanimist temple of glass, the sacred offering Well, and history in stone relief. Peopled by the Argent Fathers, in statue and light sculpture. And circled by the grand bazaar. I hear there are more people there than numbers in the void, and their chatter makes a sound wholly raw and new to the world.
Will you go there, and take my bauble? Will you offer it at the Well, where I cannot?

strings.string:
啊！那是宏伟的机神教玻璃圣殿，有献祭圣井，还有石刻的历史。银辉诸父以雕像与光雕的形貌居于其中。四周则环绕着宏大的集市。我听说那里的人多过虚空中的数目，他们的喧闹声对这世界而言全然陌生而崭新。
你愿去那里，替我带上这件宝贝吗？能否代我将它献于井中？

string.ID: Your bauble?

strings.string: 你的宝贝？

string.ID: Argent Fathers?

strings.string: 银辉诸父？

string.ID: Why can you not go?

strings.string: 你为何不能去？

string.ID: I will make the journey.

strings.string: 我会走这一趟。

string.ID: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我无法答应此事。且生且饮。

string.ID:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was scything the vine when the flat of my blade turned something loose from the soil. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...
Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

strings.string:
是啊！我的邻里亲族早听腻了这个故事。我正挥镰割藤，刀背却从土里撬出一样东西。往日见到铬，我的心也曾悸动；可亲手掘出一小片碎屑，仿佛在美之算盘上拨动一颗珠子……
那么，你愿意去吗？替我把宝贝献于井中？

string.ID: Why can you not go?

strings.string: 你为何不能去？

string.ID: What is the Six Day Stilt again?

strings.string: 六日高塔究竟是什么地方？

string.ID: I will make the journey.

strings.string: 我会走这一趟。

string.ID: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我无法答应此事。且生且饮。

string.ID:
I am no rector, understand, but They are the molders of chrome. The gods under Shekhinah who wrought metal edifices from the raw Kasaphescence.
Will you go?

strings.string:
我并非教士，你要明白，但他们乃铬的塑造者。是舍金纳座下的神祇，以原初的圣化现铸成金属圣殿。
你愿去吗？

string.ID: Perhaps. Why?

strings.string: 也许吧。为什么？

string.ID: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我无法答应此事。且生且饮。

string.ID: I would ask you make an offering at the sacred Well of my bauble. Moon and sun, I beg you!

strings.string: 我想请你替我将这件宝贝献于圣井。月与日，求你了！

string.ID: Why can you not go?

strings.string: 你为何不能去？

string.ID: What is the Six Day Stilt?

strings.string: 六日高塔是什么地方？

string.ID: I will make the journey.

strings.string: 我会走这一趟。

string.ID: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我无法答应此事。且生且饮。

string.ID:
Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of the Issachari!
There is no kindness in the Great Desert, and little more in the canyons. I cannot go and live.

strings.string:
朋友，我去了只会化作一堆焦炭，被曙光滑翔兽的光束活活烤死！或会被以萨迦人的步枪打成爬满蛞蝓的尸体！
大沙漠毫无仁慈，峡谷里也好不了多少。我不能去送死。

string.ID: What is the Six Day Stilt again?

strings.string: 六日高塔究竟是什么地方？

string.ID: I will make the journey.

strings.string: 我会走这一趟。

string.ID: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我无法答应此事。且生且饮。

string.ID:
Moon and sun, =player.formalAddressTerm=! You have my deep and many-sided thanks. Here, take the trinket now. And if you're to ever return, let us visit again.
Live and drink!

strings.string:
月与日，=player.formalAddressTerm=！我对你感激万分，恩情深重。来，把这小玩意拿去。倘若你日后归来，我们再聚一聚。
且生且饮！

string.ID:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was scything the vine when the flat of my blade turned it loose from the soil. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead toward the beam on the abacus of Beauty...
Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

strings.string:
是啊！我的邻里亲族早听腻了这个故事。我正挥镰割藤，刀背便把它从土里撬了出来。往日见到铬，我的心也曾悸动；可亲手掘出一小片碎屑，仿佛将一颗珠子拨向美之算盘的梁柱……
那么，你愿意去吗？替我把宝贝献于井中？

string.ID:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was supping on summer offal when I noticed something glinting in the guts. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...
Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

strings.string:
是啊！我的邻里亲族早听腻了这个故事。那时我正吃着夏日的内脏杂碎，忽见肠肚间有东西闪光。往日见到铬，我的心也曾悸动；可亲手掘出一小片碎屑，仿佛在美之算盘上拨动一颗珠子……
那么，你愿意去吗？替我把宝贝献于井中？

string.ID:
Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of the Issachari!
There is no kindness in the Great Desert. I cannot go and live.

strings.string:
朋友，我去了只会化作一堆焦炭，被曙光滑翔兽的光束活活烤死！或会被以萨迦人的步枪打成爬满蛞蝓的尸体！
大沙漠毫无仁慈。我不能去送死。

string.ID:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was wrenching moisture from a banner when I kicked something 'neath the salt. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...
Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

strings.string:
是啊！我的邻里亲族早听腻了这个故事。我正从旗帜上拧取水分，脚下却从盐土里踢出一样东西。往日见到铬，我的心也曾悸动；可亲手掘出一小片碎屑，仿佛在美之算盘上拨动一颗珠子……
那么，你愿意去吗？替我把宝贝献于井中？

string.ID:
Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of my kinsfolk!
There is no kindness deep in the Great Desert. I cannot go and live.

strings.string:
朋友，我去了只会化作一堆焦炭，被曙光滑翔兽的光束活活烤死！或会被我族人的步枪打成爬满蛞蝓的尸体！
大沙漠深处毫无仁慈。我不能去送死。

string.ID:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I fished it out a mound of pig stool. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...
Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

strings.string:
是啊！我的邻里亲族早听腻了这个故事。我从一堆猪粪里把它捞了出来。往日见到铬，我的心也曾悸动；可亲手掘出一小片碎屑，仿佛在美之算盘上拨动一颗珠子……
那么，你愿意去吗？替我把宝贝献于井中？

string.ID:
Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of the Issachari!
There is no kindness in the Great Desert. I cannot go and live.

strings.string:
朋友，我去了只会化作一堆焦炭，被曙光滑翔兽的光束活活烤死！或会被以萨迦人的步枪打成爬满蛞蝓的尸体！
大沙漠毫无仁慈。我不能去送死。

string.ID: -mm. Mmm? =player.FormalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: ——嗯。嗯？=player.FormalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: {{emote|*Elder Irudad smiles.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*伊鲁达德长老微笑。*}}

string.ID:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad smiles.*}}
Come in- come sit 'neath the cool shade, 'cross a pillow there.

strings.string:
{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老微笑。*}}
进来——来这片清凉的树荫下坐坐，坐在那边的垫子上。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad smiles.*}}
Live and drink, =name=. Come, sit with me.

strings.string:
{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老微笑。*}}
且生且饮，=name=。来，坐到我身旁。

string.ID:
-mm. Mmm? =player.FormalAddressTerm=?
{{emote|*Elder Irudad smiles.*}}
Live and drink. Come in- come sit 'neath the cool shade, 'cross a pillow there. And welcome to Joppa.
You may drink of our freshwater, too, and quench your thirst.

strings.string:
——嗯。嗯？=player.FormalAddressTerm=？
{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老微笑。*}}
且生且饮。进来——来这片清凉的树荫下坐坐，坐在那边的垫子上。欢迎来到约帕。
你也可以喝些我们的淡水，解解渴。

string.ID: I'm back from Red Rock with the corpse of a pale spiderling. Elder, would you examine it?

strings.string: 我从红岩回来了，带着一只苍白幼蛛的尸体。长老，能请你看看吗？

string.ID: What is this place, Joppa?

strings.string: 这里是哪里，约帕？

string.ID: Do you sell wares here?

strings.string: 你在这里卖东西吗？

string.ID: I'm looking for work.

strings.string: 我在找活干。

string.ID: I'm looking for work.

strings.string: 我在找活干。

string.ID: Can you tell me about the Gyre and the Girsh nephilim again?

strings.string: 你能再给我讲讲回旋和吉尔什拿非利人吗？

string.ID: What can you tell me about the Six Day Stilt?

strings.string: 你能告诉我一些六日高塔的事吗？

string.ID: Argyve wants me to meet the Barathrumites.

strings.string: 阿尔吉夫想让我去见巴拉斯鲁姆派。

string.ID:
-this? The oasis-hamlet. 'Neath the shelf of the world. A million breaths of salt the wind heaves over the Great Salt Desert Moghra'yi. And to the east, the rotting jungles of Qud.
Here in the crack between the two, watervine can grow, and we grow it. mmm, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string:
——这里？绿洲村落。世界的崖棚之下。咸风从大盐沙漠莫格拉伊吹来，卷过百万缕盐尘。往东，则是卡德腐朽的丛林。
夹在两者之间的这道裂隙里，水藤得以生长，我们便种植水藤。嗯，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Can you tell me about Qud?

strings.string: 你能跟我说说卡德吗？

string.ID:
-mm, there? Land slopes up and is toothed in chrome steeples, ageless things. Looming over the old-earth tunnels, pillowed in rotting jungle and fungus groves. And broken against the mounts of the north, they are, in the shadow of the Spindle...
There are people, friends, communities. And friends-to-noone, too. History is thick as the high salt sun, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and where the past is ground up like matz meal, a mix of life sets in.
-mm, adventurous ones set off for their own splinter of artifact. To both Fates, life and death...

strings.string:
——嗯，那边？大地渐渐隆起，插满铬制尖塔；那些东西亘古不变。它们俯瞰旧世隧道，掩映在腐朽丛林与菌林之间。它们撞上北方山脉，矗立于纺锤的阴影之中……
那里有人，有朋友，有社群；也有无友无伴之人。=player.formalAddressTerm=，历史如高悬的盐日般厚重；往昔被碾作无酵饼屑，生命的杂糅便由此沉淀。
——嗯，爱冒险的人会启程，去寻自己的那一片遗物。无论命运赐予生抑或死……

string.ID: -here? Speak to my daughter through the east door, for herbs. And sitting Tam in the southeast has all manner of trinket, against his chests o' drawers.

strings.string: ——这里？想买草药，便从东门去找我女儿。东南边坐着的塔姆，柜子里装着各色小玩意。

string.ID:
-mm, work? The farmers are plagued by cave vermin. You might speak to Mehmet o' there, by the southern watervine patch.
And Argyve, too, =player.formalAddressTerm=. The tinker. Always looking for trinkets to wire between, heh. Go through his hut of sheet metal, to the southwest.

strings.string:
——嗯，想找活干？农夫们正受洞窟害虫侵扰。你可以去南边的水藤田旁找梅赫梅特。
还有阿尔吉夫，=player.formalAddressTerm=。那位修补匠总在找小玩意来接线，呵。往西南去，穿过他的铁皮棚屋便是。

string.ID: -mm, work? Try Argyve, =player.formalAddressTerm=. The tinker. Always looking for trinkets to wire between, heh. Go through his hut of sheet metal, to the southwest.

strings.string: ——嗯，想找活干？去找阿尔吉夫吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。那位修补匠总在找小玩意来接线，呵。往西南去，穿过他的铁皮棚屋便是。

string.ID: -ahh, mm, such spectacle. The statues within, a revelation to the eyes. Chandlers enough to drain your skins dry 'twixt Shallows and Beetle Moon.

strings.string: ——啊，嗯，好一派奇观。里面的雕像，真是眼前的启示。从浅滩到甲虫之月之间，灯烛多得足以把你皮囊里的水都耗干。

string.ID: -mm, Barathrumites. Strange draft o'those bearfolk. They, mm, hah. They care not overly for outsiders. I hope Argyve sold you not a better welcome than you'll have.

strings.string: ——嗯，巴拉斯鲁姆派。那群熊人来历古怪。嗯，他们，哈。不怎么把外人放在心上。我盼着阿尔吉夫没把你说得以为他们会待你更好。

string.ID:
-this? Oh? Oh...
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses for several minutes.*}}
Warted leg? mm. Foul smell of sour gum? mmm. Moon and sun....
A girshling? This is a girshling.

strings.string:
——这个？哦？哦……
{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老沉默了几分钟。*}}
长疣的腿？嗯。酸胶的恶臭？嗯……月与日……
吉尔什幼体？这是只吉尔什幼体。

string.ID: What's a girshling?

strings.string: 吉尔什幼体是什么？

string.ID:
Creature of plague, =player.formalAddressTerm=. mmm. This one...
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}
This one covered in slick and muscled out the bilge hose of sleeping Agolgot, in the cave under the Cloaca...
-mm, but here? Girshling this far west? There must be hundreds for one to reach... mm, does the Gyre widen again??

strings.string:
瘟疫之兽，=player.formalAddressTerm=。嗯，这只……
{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老沉默片刻。*}}
这只浑身黏滑的家伙，从沉睡的阿戈尔戈特的舱底排水管里挤了出来，就在泄殖腔下方的洞窟里……
——嗯，可它怎么会在这里？吉尔什幼体竟到了西边这么远？得有成百上千只，才会有一只跑来……嗯，回旋又扩大了吗？？
回旋？

string.ID: I talked to a strange figure next to the girshling.

strings.string: 我和吉尔什幼体旁一个奇怪的人影说过话。

string.ID: There was a strange figure shadowing the creature...

strings.string: 有个奇怪的人影一直跟着那只怪物……

string.ID: I noticed the creature has had its fangs removed.

strings.string: 我注意到那怪物的獠牙被拔掉了。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}
-mm, plagues. Of our great grandsires many-times-over. Salt, darkness, svardym-frog... Girshling.

strings.string:
{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老沉默片刻。*}}
——嗯，瘟疫。都是许多代以前的老灾祸了。盐、黑暗、斯瓦迪姆蛙……吉尔什幼体。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}
-mm, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Do not like to sour the air with a harsh word! But this tiding bites my liver like acid. mm, must ask Nima for an elixir of yuckwheat...

strings.string:
{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老沉默片刻。*}}
——嗯，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我不愿用重话败坏气氛！可这消息像酸液一样啃噬我的肝。嗯，得向尼玛讨一剂苦麦药汁……

string.ID: I talked to a strange figure next to the girshling.

strings.string: 我和吉尔什幼体旁一个奇怪的人影说过话。

string.ID: There was a strange figure shadowing the creature...

strings.string: 有个奇怪的人影一直跟着那只怪物……

string.ID: I noticed the creature has had its fangs removed.

strings.string: 我注意到那怪物的獠牙被拔掉了。

string.ID: I am sorry to cause pain, Elder.

strings.string: 长老，很抱歉让你难过。

string.ID: -mm, oh? In dyed robes, flashing gestures of hand? And ranting about pipe milk? A gyre wight, must be. They about worship the Girsh nephilim as gods.

strings.string: ——嗯？哦？身穿染色长袍，手势闪个不停？还嚷嚷管道奶？那定是回旋尸鬼。他们几乎把吉尔什拿非利人奉为神明。

string.ID: Girsh nephilim?

strings.string: 吉尔什拿非利人？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}
-mm, nephilim. Seventh plague. Girsh titans born on the Moon Stair, and quickened to life to eat our young. Sultan Resheph drove them back a chiliad ago, away to slumber. mm, do they rouse?

strings.string:
{{emote|*伊鲁达德长老沉默片刻。*}}
——嗯，拿非利人。第七灾。吉尔什巨人诞生于月阶，醒来便要吞食我们的孩子。千年前，苏丹利悉将他们驱退，令其远去沉眠。嗯，他们醒了吗？

string.ID: -mm, oh? A gyre wight, must be. They bind the teeth right up to their own gums, to make a show for the Girsh nephilim.

strings.string: ——嗯，哦？定是回旋尸鬼。他们把牙齿一直绑到自己的牙龈上，好在吉尔什拿非利人面前做出一副样子。

string.ID: Girsh nephilim?

strings.string: 吉尔什拿非利人？

string.ID:
-mm? No, =player.formalAddressTerm=! Your finding is rich in value to us. We are poor farmers, and sharpen our vinereapers is all we can do. But others? Perhaps more.
Take these prickly-boons as thanks. mm, I will not soon forget this, =name=. Leave me now to muse, kindly...

strings.string:
——嗯？不，=player.formalAddressTerm=！你带来的发现对我们意义重大。我们不过是穷苦农夫，所能做的只有磨利割藤刀。但旁人或许能做得更多。
收下这些带刺的谢礼吧。嗯，我不会很快忘记此事，=name=。请让我独自沉思一会儿……

string.ID:
-mm, yes? Plagues, a chiliad old. Seven such: girshlings, darkness. mm, svardym-frog...
Ah, nephilim, too, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Girsh titans who eat the young of kith and kin. Sultan Resheph drove them under the earth, but do they stir??

strings.string:
——嗯，是啊？那些古老的瘟疫。共有七种：吉尔什幼体、黑暗、嗯，斯瓦迪姆蛙……
啊，还有拿非利人，=player.formalAddressTerm=。吉尔什巨人，以族中幼者为食。苏丹利悉把他们赶入地下，可他们是否又在蠢动？？

string.ID: -mm, oh? You're wondering if they might come to Joppa, then?

strings.string: ——嗯，哦？你是在想他们会不会来约帕，对吧？

string.ID: mm, I am for you, =name=. Any friend of yours is too a friend of Joppa, and if those friends desire shelter I wouldn't dare turn them away. I only hope these lilypad-folk have the patience for a farmer's life. -mm, not as exciting here as it was in the Palladium Reef.

strings.string: 嗯，我支持你，=name=。你的朋友也是约帕的朋友；若他们想要庇护，我可不敢拒绝。我只盼这些睡莲叶般的族人能耐得住农夫的日子。——嗯，这里可不如钯礁那般热闹。

string.ID: You have my thanks, Elder.

strings.string: 多谢你，长老。

string.ID: -mm, blessings upon your generous heart, =name=. I mean no slight to these slynth, but it is too great a favor you ask of the people of Joppa.

strings.string: ——嗯，愿慷慨之心蒙福，=name=。我并非轻视这些斯林斯，只是你所求之事，对约帕众人而言实在太难应允。

string.ID: Have you spoken to the slynth, =name=? I am curious to hear what destination they choose.

strings.string: =name=，你和斯林斯谈过了吗？我很想知道他们会选择何处作为目的地。

string.ID:
-mm, your luminous friends are settling in quite well.
There is yet a pall of ennui among some, but such is the case for any party of brave migrants. Ah, they will find their ground or their path, all in time. Some farmers show some small discomfort but that will pass in time.

strings.string:
嗯，你那些发光的朋友安顿得很好。
有些人仍旧郁郁寡欢，但任何一群勇敢的迁徙者都会如此。啊，他们终会找到立足之地，或是自己的道路。有些农夫略感不自在，时日一长也会过去。

string.ID: My thanks, Elder.

strings.string: 多谢，长老。

string.ID:
-mm, ah, =name=. Come see how the slynth have become a part of Joppa!
Some cared not for the slow pace of our lives and struck out on their own, and with their thews and wits I have no doubt they will live to find purpose. mm, others are welcome to grow and flourish here in our marshes.

strings.string:
嗯，啊，=name=。来看看斯林斯人如何融入约帕吧！
有些人不喜欢我们缓慢的生活步调，便自行出发了。凭他们的筋骨和才智，我相信他们定能活下去，找到自己的志向。嗯，其他人则可以在我们的沼泽里生根繁衍。

string.ID: My thanks again, Elder.

strings.string: 再次感谢，长老。

string.ID: Live and drink, =name=. Any news from Red Rock?

strings.string: 且生且饮，=name=。红岩那边有什么消息？

string.ID: Yes. I found the vermin and bits of gnawed watervine. I carry one's corpse with me.

strings.string: 有。我找到了害兽和被啃过的水藤碎片，还带回了一具尸体。

string.ID: None yet.

strings.string: 还没有。

string.ID: Live and drink, =name=.

strings.string: 且生且饮，=name=。

string.ID: Taste what on the wind today, =name=?

strings.string: 今天风里尝出什么味道了，=name=？

string.ID: Moon and sun, =name=.

strings.string: 月与日，=name=。

string.ID: I can taste lime, =name=. And mayhaps gallium?

strings.string: 我尝到了石灰味，=name=。也许还有镓？

string.ID: Aye, the pest-vanquisher! Live and drink, =name=.

strings.string: 啊，是除害英雄！且生且饮，=name=。

string.ID: A waterhand? Aye. Live and drink, traveller.

strings.string: 水手？啊。且生且饮，旅人。

string.ID: I am called =name=.

strings.string: 我叫=name=。

string.ID: Can you tell me about your village, Joppa?

strings.string: 能给我讲讲你们的村子约帕吗？

string.ID: I am in search of work.

strings.string: 我在找活干。

string.ID: Mehmet, the tongue says. Live and drink, =name=.

strings.string: 舌头说的是梅赫梅特。且生且饮，=name=。

string.ID: Watervine farm in the lap of the marsh. You've sucked the moisture out a vinewafer, yea? We tend the plant here.

strings.string: 沼泽怀里的水藤农场。你吸过藤饼里的水分吧？我们就在这儿种那植物。

string.ID:
Wind off the Great Desert cools a touch and gives up moisture. Just enough. A tongue can taste a hundred kinds of wind, y'know?
Anywhile, that's where my wandering mind goes. More's about Joppa I say speak to our Elderfriend. Irudad. Up northwise the path.

strings.string:
大沙漠吹来的风稍稍凉下来，就会吐出水分。刚刚好。你知道吗，舌头能尝出上百种风的味道？
总之，我这心思又飘远了。想多了解约帕，就去找我们的长老朋友伊鲁达德说话。沿路往北走。

string.ID:
Aye? I have it, then.
Somethin' is eating our watervine, 'round Beetle Moon. Q-ruun says he saw a creature, spider-like, slinking in the brine. But no cave spider would dare get so near Warden's stomps.
I tasted a bit of red fleck in the pool. Shale, like we find in the soil by Red Rock...

strings.string:
是吗？那我有活给你。
有什么东西在啃我们的水藤，就在甲虫之月前后。Q-鲁恩说他看见一只蜘蛛似的东西在盐水里溜来溜去。可洞穴蜘蛛哪敢靠守望者的脚步这么近。
我在池水里尝到一点红色的碎屑。是页岩，就像红岩附近土里的那种……

string.ID:
Hike there, will you? To Red Rock. Just about two parasangs north of Joppa.
Kill the vermin and bring one's corpse back, for seein' what it is. Elder will take care to pay you after, waterhand.

strings.string:
你愿意走一趟吗？去红岩，就在约帕以北大约两帕拉桑。
杀了那害兽，带一具尸体回来，让我们看看是什么。长老会付你报酬的，水手。

string.ID: I will do as you ask.

strings.string: 我会照办。

string.ID: I'm not interested.

strings.string: 我没兴趣。
好。

string.ID:
Oh? Oh. {{emote|*Mehmet pauses.*}}
Don't like the look o' that thing. Best bring it to Elder. Hut's northwise up the path.

strings.string:
哦？哦。{{emote|*梅赫梅特顿了顿。*}}
这东西看着可不妙。最好拿给长老看。他的小屋沿路往北走就到。

string.ID: As you say.

strings.string: 依你所言。
=generic=

string.ID: =player.apparentSpecies=? We are greeted! What do you desire?

strings.string: =player.apparentSpecies=？我们受到问候了！你有什么需要？

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是=name=。你是谁？

string.ID: Do you live here?

strings.string: 你住在这里吗？

string.ID: What kind of creature are you?

strings.string: 你是什么生物？

string.ID: I desire nothing. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我没有什么需要。且生且饮。

string.ID: It is a pleasure to know this, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm= =name=! I am Tam.

strings.string: 很高兴知道这些，=player.apparentSpecies==player.formalAddressTerm==name=！我是塔姆。

string.ID:
Joppa is my home, yes.
I walked Moghra'yi in the caravans of my brethren and the saltback, but upon meeting Elder Irudad, knew at once to settle down here. You will understand, =player.formalAddressTerm= =player.apparentSpecies=, if you speak to him.

strings.string:
是的，约帕是我的家。
我曾随同胞和驮盐兽的商队走过莫格拉伊，但见到伊鲁达德长老后，便立刻决定在这里定居。你若与他说话，就会明白的，=player.formalAddressTerm==player.apparentSpecies=。

string.ID: I am dromad, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm=. Some say saltstrider. Do you know this?

strings.string: 我是单峰驼商，=player.apparentSpecies==player.formalAddressTerm=。有人称我们为踏盐者。你知道吗？

string.ID: I do.

strings.string: 愿意。

string.ID: I do not.

strings.string: 不知道。

string.ID: My people have walked the salt for thousands of years, meeting every creature that lives and thinks. From Pale Sea to the marsh of Joppa, and under the Hanging Hills, our chests are drawn.

strings.string: 我的族人在盐地上行走了数千年，遇见过所有活着的、有思想的生灵。从苍海到约帕的沼泽，再到悬丘之下，我们的货箱都曾被拖行而过。

string.ID: =player.apparentSpecies=? We are greeted! What do you desire?

strings.string: =player.apparentSpecies=？我们受到问候了！你有什么需要？

string.ID: What kind of creature are you?

strings.string: 你是什么生物？

string.ID: I desire nothing. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我没有什么需要。且生且饮。

string.ID: I am dromad, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm=. Some say saltstrider. Do you know this?

strings.string: 我是单峰驼商，=player.apparentSpecies==player.formalAddressTerm=。有人称我们为踏盐者。你知道吗？

string.ID:
Psst!
Hey, can I interest you in some Consortium wares?

strings.string:
嘘！
嘿，有兴趣看看植体联盟的货物吗？

string.ID: Welcome a-Joppa, friend. Stay peacelike, and we stay friends, hyeh? You make trouble, it's my work a-split you open like a croc.

strings.string: 欢迎来到约帕，朋友。你安分守己，咱们就是朋友，嗯？你要闹事，我的活儿就是像剖鳄鱼一样把你剖开。

string.ID: Elder's over my right shoulder, chemist a-left. I ask you pick one or turn around. I en't here for chat.

strings.string: 长老在我右肩那边，药剂师在左边。你选一个去，或者转身走人。我不是来闲聊的。

string.ID: Live and drink, yonderling.

strings.string: 且生且饮，远来的客。

string.ID: {{emote|*Yrame grunts.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*伊拉梅哼了一声。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*Yrame nods.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*伊拉梅点了点头。*}}

string.ID: What follows, then?

strings.string: 接下来呢？

string.ID: Got an eyeful, heh?

strings.string: 开了眼了吧，嘿？

string.ID: Well. They en't ended you yet.

strings.string: 嗯。他们还没把你了结呢。

string.ID: I must search the Rustwells.

strings.string: 我须去搜寻锈井。

string.ID: Mehmet has bade me travel to Red Rock.

strings.string: 梅赫梅特嘱我前往红岩。

string.ID: I depart for Grit Gate soon.

strings.string: 我不日便启程去砂砾门。

string.ID: I journey North, to the Six Day Stilt.

strings.string: 我要北上，往六日高塔去。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: What is a Warden?

strings.string: 守望者是做什么的？

string.ID: Called Yrame, Warden a-Joppa. I kill trouble. Don't be trouble.

strings.string: 叫伊拉梅，约帕的守望者。我专杀祸事。你别成了祸事。

string.ID: Nigh every settlement a-Qud keeps a Warden. We snuff threats to the peace.

strings.string: 卡德几乎每处聚落都设一名守望者。我们掐灭一切危及安宁的东西。

string.ID: Out East? Uegh. Wouldn't go, I. Git ta Qudzu. Like as rust the pauldrons right off a-shoulders.

strings.string: 往东？呃。我是不去的。到了卡德葛那儿，保管锈得你肩上的护肩甲片一块块脱落。

string.ID: Up North? En't far. See them baboons, you put one's light out for me.

strings.string: 往北？不远。见着那些狒狒，替我送一只上路。

string.ID: Don't say? Well. Fates favor your feet, hyeh.

strings.string: 当真？那好。愿命运眷顾你的脚步，嘿。

string.ID: If you don't get dry-roasted by the fire snakes, ought be a time of times. Better hit all the food stalls for samples, hyeh?

strings.string: 若没叫火蛇烤成肉干，该是一趟盛事。把各家食摊都逛遍，尝尝样品，嘿？

string.ID: Ahh, there is a new face. I am Nima Ruda, town apothecary. If your feet point to Qud, you'll need some of my wares before you go.

strings.string: 啊，来了张新面孔。我是尼玛·鲁达，镇上的药剂师。你若是要往卡德深处去，动身前总得买些我的货。

string.ID: Live and drink, wayfarer.

strings.string: 且生且饮，行路人。

string.ID: Time and rest are the surest way to dress a wound, but my wares can help if you're in a hurry.

strings.string: 时日与歇息是疗伤最稳妥的法子，可你若赶时间，我这些货也能帮上忙。

string.ID: The Fates watch you, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 命运注视着你，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Don't let your nostrums run dry on the road. I have what you need.

strings.string: 莫让你的灵药在路上用尽了。你要的我这儿都有。

string.ID: What wares do you offer?

strings.string: 你卖些什么货？

string.ID: Where are you from?

strings.string: 你是哪里人？

string.ID: Witchwood for pain, bandages for bleeding, yuckwheat and honey for when your guts act up. Coldcaps when I can find them. Why not take a look?

strings.string: 止痛有巫木，止血有绷带，肚腹不适则用苦麦与蜂蜜。冷菇若能寻到也有。何不看一看？

string.ID: I grew up right here in Joppa, daughter of the Elder and all. Spent some years delving, but gave it up after a few near escapes and nearly deadly wounds. I'm better suited to herbalism anyway, and my father worries less.

strings.string: 我就在约帕这里长大，是长老的女儿，诸如此类。曾在外探掘了几年，几番死里逃生，又受过几近致命的重伤，便罢手了。我本就更适合做草药师，家父也少些担忧。

string.ID: Will you inherit leadership of Joppa from your father?

strings.string: 你会从令尊手里接掌约帕的领导之位吗？

string.ID: Fates forfend. I would hardly like to lead a village and run a shop at the same time.

strings.string: 命运禁止。我可不愿既领一座村子，又开一间铺子。

string.ID: Fair enough. Live and drink.

strings.string: 也是。且生且饮。

string.ID: Live and drink, traveler. Moist starapples for the road?

strings.string: 旅人，且生且饮。带几个多汁的星苹果上路吗？

string.ID: Mind the trees, =player.formalAddressTerm=. They ain't yours.

strings.string: 看好那些树，=player.formalAddressTerm=。它们可不是你的。

string.ID: Now you keep your eyes off my young, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 你的眼睛离我的幼苗远点，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Can't go wrong with starapples, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Good for what ails ya.

strings.string: 星苹果准没错，=player.formalAddressTerm=。有什么毛病都能治。

string.ID: You know how to make starapple jam? If not, you can buy it from me.

strings.string: 你可知道怎么做星苹果酱？不会的话，可以向我买。

string.ID: Spread starapple on yer matz! It's proof against thirst and harm alike.

strings.string: 把星苹果抹在你的马茨上！既防干渴，又防伤害。

string.ID: See my whiskers? Starapples. They'll boost your virility threefold.

strings.string: 瞧见我的胡须没？星苹果之功。保你的雄风涨上三倍。

string.ID: Live and drink, traveler. Are you hungry?

strings.string: 旅人，且生且饮。饿了吗？

string.ID: Git ta pig mud. Mud?

strings.string: 去猪泥那儿。泥？
嗯？

string.ID: Mind the pig leavins, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 当心猪的遗留物，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Now don't you go breaking my fence.

strings.string: 可别把我的篱笆弄坏了。

string.ID: You best not hurt my critters.

strings.string: 你最好别伤了我的牲口。

string.ID: I en't filthy. I'm muddy. Big difference.

strings.string: 我不脏。我是沾了泥。差别大着呢。

string.ID: It's get meat here or risk a slugsnout ball in the gut. Your choice, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 要么在这儿买肉，要么冒险吃蛞蝓鼻兽一记肚子上的球。你选吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Good clean meat! Well. Clean as it gets.

strings.string: 上好的干净肉！呃，也就干净到这个份上。

string.ID: Moon and sun, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 月与日，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Now don't you fret. My crabs are docile as dogs.

strings.string: 别慌。我的螃蟹温顺得像狗。

string.ID: Get close if you like, they don't pinch.

strings.string: 想凑近就凑近，它们不夹人。

string.ID: You ever run into one of these in the wild? The lengths some folks will go for a crab leg!

strings.string: 你在野外碰上过这玩意儿吗？为了一条蟹腿，有些人什么都干得出来！

string.ID: I hand-reared each one of these critters. They've had a life of luxury.

strings.string: 这些小家伙都是我亲手养大的。它们过的是养尊处优的日子。

string.ID: Stressed crab means tough crab meat. Buy domesticated meat.

strings.string: 蟹受了惊吓，肉就老。买家养的肉吧。

string.ID: Ain't they precious? Cute little buggers.

strings.string: 可爱吧？这些小东西，多招人疼。

string.ID: My crabs are as gentle as can be. Delicious, too.

strings.string: 我的螃蟹再温和不过了。味道也好。

string.ID: They say we'll all be crabs, eventually.

strings.string: 都说咱们终究都会变成螃蟹。

string.ID: Need something?

strings.string: 要点什么？
嗯。

string.ID: Sorry bout the smell.

strings.string: 抱歉，味道有点冲。

string.ID: Watch for blood puddles.

strings.string: 留神血洼。

string.ID: No lie, I love my job.

strings.string: 说真的，我爱这份差事。

string.ID: Leeches. Blood. If that's what you want, I got what you want.

strings.string: 水蛭，血。你要的若是这个，我这儿都有。

string.ID: I feed these critters what blood the ranchers have to spare.

strings.string: 牧场主们匀得出多少血，我就拿多少喂这些小家伙。

string.ID: Sorry. Lost focus a bit. What do you need?

strings.string: 抱歉，走神了一会儿。你需要什么？

string.ID: Blood tastes all right, but I can't fathom living on it.

strings.string: 血的味道还行，可我实在想不通怎么能靠它过活。

string.ID: By the Eaters, I'm exhausted. May I help you?

strings.string: 食者在上，我累坏了。有什么能帮你的吗？

string.ID: Please don't open the gate.

strings.string: 求你，别开那道门。

string.ID: I beg you. Do not release the cats.

strings.string: 我求你了。别放走那些猫。

string.ID: I'll buy your shiniest things, if you'll sell them.

strings.string: 你若肯卖，你最闪亮的物件我都买。

string.ID: I'm a cat herder. My parents were cat herders. Their parents were cat herders, and their parents. I don't understand why we do what we do but it is all I know.

strings.string: 我是牧猫人。我父母是牧猫人，他们的父母也是，再往上亦然。我不明白我们为何做这行，可我只会这个。

string.ID: I've a glimmer of light for sale if you need one, wanderer.

strings.string: 我有一缕微光待售，你若需要，旅人。

string.ID: The cats are not for sale.

strings.string: 猫不卖。

string.ID: I'm like to faint from this heat.

strings.string: 这热劲儿，我怕是要晕过去了。

string.ID: Mind your footing! Ha ha ha!

strings.string: 脚下留神！哈哈哈！

string.ID: Takes a simple person to tend a simple creature. I don't mind it.

strings.string: 侍弄简单的生灵，只需简单的人。我不嫌。

string.ID: Bless this mess and bless you, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 愿这一团狼藉得福，也愿你得福，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: What can I do for you? Need slime?

strings.string: 有什么能为你效劳？要黏液吗？

string.ID: Have you ever taken a swig of slime? It's not half bad!

strings.string: 你可曾灌过一口黏液？味道不算太差！

string.ID: I keep my amoebas happy! Or, you know, whatever they got in place of happy.

strings.string: 我把变形虫们照料得很快活！呃，或者说，它们那玩意儿，算是快活的替代吧。

string.ID: See how their skin glisters in the salt sun? Lovely.

strings.string: 瞧它们的皮在盐日下闪着光，多可爱。

string.ID: Now don't you dare pop my amoeba.

strings.string: 你可千万别戳破我的变形虫。

string.ID: I think I got all the puddles, but watch for slime all the same.

strings.string: 水洼我想是都清干净了，不过还是留意黏液吧。

string.ID: Step in. Take shelter from the salt.

strings.string: 进来吧。躲躲盐。

string.ID: What mazes and mandalas could be crafted by human hands that hope to surpass what nature wrought eons before our creation?

strings.string: 人手所造的迷宫与曼荼罗，如何能胜过早于我们诞生亿万年的造化之功？

string.ID: How sublime, the striations of the snail shell. And such a lovely word, striation.

strings.string: 蜗壳上的条纹，何其崇高。“条纹”二字，又何其可爱。

string.ID: I think often upon the gyre, from Resheph's gospels. Why do you imagine it is so named?

strings.string: 我常思索利悉福音中的回旋。依你看，它为何得此名？

string.ID: Even in the imperfections of a spiral shell we see the perfection of nature.

strings.string: 螺旋之壳纵有瑕疵，我们也能从中窥见自然的完满。

string.ID: My snails aren't so suited to this climate. Some days I spend more water keeping them properly slimy than I make in sales.

strings.string: 我的蜗牛不太适应这里的气候。有些日子，我为让它们保持恰当的黏滑所耗的水，比卖出的还多。

string.ID: Snails find the spiral of another shell familiar and comforting. Should you wear one, they will look upon you favorably.

strings.string: 蜗牛觉得别的螺旋壳亲切安心。你若佩戴一枚，它们便会青眼相待。

string.ID: There is kinship from mollusk to mollusk. What secrets do they know that we do not?

strings.string: 软体动物之间自有亲缘。它们知晓什么，是我们不知的秘密？

string.ID: What d'ya want.

strings.string: 要什么。

string.ID: Goat meat keeps good. Buy some afore you head back to the salt.

strings.string: 羊肉耐放。回盐地之前买些吧。

string.ID: What, you need a menu? I got goat meat and goat jerky.

strings.string: 怎么，还要菜单？我有羊肉和羊肉干。

string.ID: I hate my goats and they hate me, but we both hate every other body more.

strings.string: 我恨我的羊，它们也恨我，可我们更恨别的所有人。

string.ID: Absolutely miserable weather. Whatcha want?

strings.string: 这鬼天气，糟透了。想要啥？

string.ID: Meat for sale.

strings.string: 卖肉。

string.ID: Goats ain't fun to travel with, but they're good protection.

strings.string: 带羊赶路没什么意思，不过它们倒是好护卫。

string.ID: I didn't ask for this life, but here we are. Wanna buy something?

strings.string: 这日子不是我求来的，可事已至此。想买点什么？

string.ID: Some say beetle jerky is too sour. I say, learn to cook!

strings.string: 有人说甲虫肉干太酸。我说，学着做菜去！

string.ID: Look at their chitin! See the sheen? Means they're healthy.

strings.string: 瞧它们的甲壳！看这光泽？说明它们健康。

string.ID: Beetles are fine companions, but don't leave your backpack and your pet beetlebum in the same room.

strings.string: 甲虫是好伙伴，可别把你的背包和你的宠物甲虫臀兽留在同一间屋里。

string.ID: Nothing wrong with beetle meat. Come, try it.

strings.string: 甲虫肉没什么不好。来，尝尝。

string.ID: Beetle jerky holds its own. You learn to appreciate the aftertaste.

strings.string: 甲虫肉干自有其味。余味慢慢就懂得欣赏了。

string.ID: Meat, fresh and preserved alike, all at reasonable prices.

strings.string: 鲜肉腌肉，一应俱全，价钱公道。

string.ID: Come to see my beasts? All hale and well-fed, I assure you.

strings.string: 来看我的牲口？个个康健，吃得饱，我保证。

string.ID: Live and eat honey.

strings.string: 且生且食蜜。

string.ID: Oh, look. It is a not-bear. Greetings, not-bear.

strings.string: 哦，瞧。是只非熊。你好，非熊。

string.ID: Live and drink, little friend.

strings.string: 且生且饮，小友。

string.ID: I would enjoy some honey.

strings.string: 我想吃点蜂蜜。
{{emote|*咕哝*}}
{{emote|*嗅了嗅*}}
{{emote|*呼哧呼哧*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*heavy sigh*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*重重叹了口气*}}
{{emote|*叹息*}}

string.ID: Oh my, what a cute not-bear. Greetings, cute not-bear.

strings.string: 哎呀，好可爱的非熊。你好啊，可爱的非熊。
哦。
嗯。

string.ID: Hmm. Oh! Greetings.

strings.string: 嗯。哦！你好。
是？

string.ID: Excuse me.

strings.string: 借过。

string.ID: Oh. Live and drink, not-bear.

strings.string: 哦。且生且饮，非熊。

string.ID: I cannot decide which I like best: berries, meat, or honey? I simply cannot decide.

strings.string: 我拿不定主意最爱哪样：浆果、肉，还是蜂蜜？实在拿不定。

string.ID: Glowfish are not the tastiest food, but they are the prettiest.

strings.string: 荧光鱼不是最好吃的，却是最好看的。

string.ID: I once traveled over a mountain, believing I would see something that I had not seen before once past the summit. I was disappointed to find that the other side of the mountain bore a striking resemblance to the one I'd just left. What is the purpose of mountains?

strings.string: 我曾翻越一座山，以为过了山顶便能见到前所未见之物。谁知山的那一边与我刚离开的这一边惊人地相似，我大失所望。山，究竟是为了什么？

string.ID: Live and eat honey, bear friend.

strings.string: 且生且食蜜，熊友。
唔。
猎物。
嗯嗯呃。

string.ID: I'm hungry.

strings.string: 我饿。

string.ID: Live and... be eaten.

strings.string: 且生且……被吃。

string.ID: {{emote|*licks lips*}}

肉。

string.ID: Keep your distance, friend.

strings.string: 离远点，朋友。

string.ID: {{emote|*nods mutely*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*默默点头*}}

string.ID: Shh. Listen.

strings.string: 嘘。听。

string.ID: I am peaceful.

strings.string: 我没有敌意。

string.ID: Any dangers?

strings.string: 有什么危险吗？

string.ID: {{emote|*ignores you*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*对你视而不见*}}

string.ID: Let's not linger together.

strings.string: 咱们别在一处逗留。

string.ID: May the Eaters gift you.

strings.string: 愿食者赐福于你。

string.ID: Scrap for goods?

strings.string: 用废料换货？

string.ID: I might be willing to trade.

strings.string: 我或许愿意交易。

string.ID: {{emote|*shakes =pronouns.possessive= head*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*摇了摇=pronouns.possessive=头*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*puts a finger to =pronouns.possessive= lips*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*将一根手指竖在=pronouns.possessive=唇前*}}

string.ID: I'm armed. Don't try anything.

strings.string: 我带着家伙。别耍花样。

string.ID: {{emote|*tenses as you approach*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*你走近时，对方绷紧了身子*}}

string.ID: Found anything good?

strings.string: 找到什么好东西没？

string.ID: Finders keepers.

strings.string: 谁捡到归谁。

string.ID: Lot of good stuff down here. Lots of bad stuff too.

strings.string: 这底下好东西多，坏东西也多。

string.ID: Live and drink, wayfarer.

strings.string: 且生且饮，行路人。
嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。
嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿！

string.ID: ehe. ehehe. ehehehehehehe!

啥！

咿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。

strings.string: 且生且饮且生且饮且生且饮嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。
且生饮。
且声引。

string.ID: liffen drick.

strings.string: 且僧饮。

string.ID: libm drin. ehehehe. lipum dronk! ahahahahah!

strings.string: 且生印。嘿嘿嘿嘿。且升饮！啊哈哈哈哈！

strings.string: 且生且饮，嘿嘿。

嘿嘿嘿。

呼。

string.ID: ehehe! ehehehe! AHAHAHAH!

strings.string: 呃嘿，你为啥跟我说话？
嘿嘿。
哈！
嘎哈哈！
啊哈哈哈！
嘟呵呵呵呵呵。

string.ID: oooh hohohohoho.

strings.string: 噢呵呵呵呵呵。

string.ID: geh heh heh heh heh.

strings.string: 嘎嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。
啊哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

string.ID: ...live and drink.

strings.string: ……且生且饮。

string.ID: By the sun, you're ugly.

strings.string: 看在太阳的份上，你可真丑。

string.ID: Pick a direction and walk in it.

strings.string: 挑个方向走吧。

string.ID: What do you want, lack-salt?

strings.string: 你要什么，缺盐的？

string.ID: Got nothing to say to a lack-salt.

strings.string: 跟缺盐的没话说。

string.ID: Keep your eyes moving, lack-salt.

strings.string: 眼睛别停，缺盐的。

string.ID: Hey lack-salt. How much water you got? No, don't ever answer that question.

strings.string: 嘿，缺盐的。你有多少水？不，永远别回答这个问题。

string.ID: Be respectful of the red-and-white and we will get along.

strings.string: 敬重红白之旗，咱们就相安无事。

string.ID: Keep your mouth covered, or the brine air will cure your lungs to jerky.

strings.string: 把嘴捂好，不然盐卤的空气会把你的肺腌成肉干。

string.ID: Stay warm, lack-salt.

strings.string: 保暖，缺盐的。

string.ID: Stay dry, lack-salt.

strings.string: 保干，缺盐的。

string.ID: Glory to Shekhinah.

strings.string: 荣耀归于舍金纳。

string.ID: Humble before my Fathers, I walk.

strings.string: 我谦卑地走在诸父面前。

string.ID: Live and drink, traveler. Show mercy to a weary pilgrim.

strings.string: 旅人，且生且饮。请怜悯一位疲惫的朝圣者。

string.ID: Praise be upon Nisroch, who shelters us stiltseekers.

strings.string: 赞美尼斯洛，他庇护我们这些寻塔者。

string.ID: Live and drink, traveler.

strings.string: 旅人，且生且饮。

string.ID: Live and drink, wayfarer.

strings.string: 且生且饮，行路人。

string.ID: Come. Browse my wares, =player.formalAddressTerm=!

strings.string: 来，看看我的货吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=！

string.ID: I see my wares catch your eye, =player.formalAddressTerm=. They can be yours.

strings.string: 我见我的货物入了你的眼，=player.formalAddressTerm=。它们可以归你。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 且生且饮，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: I have what you need, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 你需要的我这儿都有，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, thank the Eaters that you have found Qud's only honest shopkeep.

strings.string: 啊，=player.formalAddressTerm=，感谢食者，让你遇上了卡德唯一诚实的店家。

string.ID: On my honor, =player.formalAddressTerm=, my goods are of only the highest quality and I offer a fair trade.

strings.string: 以我的名誉担保，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我的货只有上乘品质，买卖也公道。

string.ID: Welcome, traveler.

strings.string: 欢迎，旅人。

string.ID: Welcome, =player.formalAddressTerm=. How may I serve you today?

strings.string: 欢迎，=player.formalAddressTerm=。今日有何可效劳的？

string.ID: Do your waterskins grow heavy, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 你的水囊是不是渐渐沉了，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: =player.FormalAddressTerm=, I beseech you. Enter.

strings.string: =player.FormalAddressTerm=，我恳请你，请进。

string.ID: Buy something, will you?

strings.string: 买点什么吧，行不行？

string.ID: May you find shade and vittle, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 愿你得荫凉与口粮，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Be quick about it.

strings.string: 快着点。

string.ID: By the Eaters, have you ever seen so much treasure?

strings.string: 食者在上，你可曾见过这么多宝贝？

string.ID: Live and drink, traveler. Welcome to the Stilt.

strings.string: 旅人，且生且饮。欢迎来到高塔。

string.ID: Praise be to Shekhinah! O, sovereign Fathers... at last, I am here!

strings.string: 赞美舍金纳！哦，威严的诸父……我终于到了！

string.ID: This is the Six Day Stilt, huh. It's... colossal, beautiful. I see why the chrome stewards gather here.

strings.string: 这就是六日高塔啊。它……宏伟，壮美。难怪铬钢执事们都聚到这里。

string.ID: So... many... folks....
Is it true what they say? That it's a petrified kraken?

strings.string: 传说它是一头石化的海怪，是真的吗？

string.ID: What a grand bazaar! What's in each of these tents?

strings.string: 好大的集市！这些帐篷里各卖些什么？

string.ID: Live and drink, wardens.

strings.string: 且生且饮，守望者们。

string.ID: You are among friends here, pilgrim. Stay peaceful.

strings.string: 朝圣者，你在这里都是朋友。保持安宁。

string.ID:
Then you're not of the faith =player.reflexive=, huh? Me neither. Do go inside, though. She's a beauty. Got dyed glass high in her rafters, she does. And two marvelous carvings on the wings. Plus a light-sculpture of a god. Hear the sermon, too, as you like. The high priest is persuasive, but not half as persuasive as the cathedral herself. In beauty there is power, you know.
Either way, while you're in the cathedral or on the Stiltgrounds, stay peaceful.

strings.string:
这么说，=player.reflexive=也不是教中人，是吧？我也不是。不过还是进去瞧瞧吧。她可是个美人。椽梁高处嵌着染色玻璃，两翼上有两幅绝妙的雕刻，还有一尊神明的光雕。想听布道也随你。大祭司能言善辩，可再善辩也不及大教堂自身的一半。美之中自有力量，你知道的。
无论如何，你在大教堂里也好，在高塔之地上也好，都要保持安宁。

string.ID:
Aye, aye. The clamor of it all can overwhelm.
The glowcrows say 'twas a bird-god who taught folks to gather like this, in large flocks. So blame birds.

strings.string:
是啊，是啊。这一切的喧嚣，叫人招架不住。
辉鸦说，是一位鸟神教会了人们这样成群聚居。要怪就怪鸟吧。

string.ID:
Who knows? I've wondered it myself. Sometimes she'll catch my eye, when the moon's silver-bright, and she's there bearing down on the flats.
Whatever she is, she's gigantic. And old. Real old. Way older than the cathedral the Mechanimists built inside her.

strings.string:
谁知道呢？我自己也曾纳闷。有时月色银亮，她会入我眼帘，沉沉压在平原之上。
不管她是什么，总之庞大无比，又古老，非常古老。比机神教徒在她腹中建起的大教堂古老得多。

string.ID:
Are you mad? You think I keep a tally of every shopkeeper that steps foot on the Stiltgrounds? They come and go as they please. You've got merchants of all types here. Winesellers, honey hawkers, bookbinders, cobblers.
Have a look around for =player.reflexive=. Following the road around the Stilt. There's tents the whole way round.

strings.string:
你疯了吗？你以为每个踏上高塔之地的店家，我都记着账？他们来去随意。各色商贩这儿都有：卖酒的、贩蜜的、装订书的、做鞋的。
=player.reflexive=去看看吧。沿着环绕高塔的路走，一圈下来全是帐篷。

string.ID: Live and learn, wanderer. Have you come across any books or scrolls in your travels? Do you care to donate one to the cathedral library? Whenever you return, you may speak to me and read anything you've donated.

strings.string: 且生且学，漂泊者。你一路上可曾遇到什么书卷典册？愿意捐一部给大教堂的藏书楼吗？你何时再来，只管与我说话，凡你捐过的都可阅览。
愿意。

string.ID: Where is the library?

strings.string: 藏书楼在哪里？

string.ID: What use is a library in this salt den? Or in the marshes, strangled by wild plants and poisoned by the glow? Wouldn't a stash of vinereapers serve us better?

strings.string: 在这盐窟里，要藏书楼何用？或在被野草勒颈、被辉光毒害的沼泽里？囤一批藤镰不是更有益吗？

string.ID: Not today. Live and drink, chronicler.

strings.string: 今日不了。且生且饮，编年史官。

string.ID: You imagine they will thrive here at the Stiltgrounds, among the faithful?

strings.string: 你以为他们在高塔之地、在信众之中能够兴旺吗？

string.ID: I do.

strings.string: 愿意。

string.ID: This wouldn't be the first time the Stiltgrounds have hosted refugees, =name=, and make no mistake: it is a burden upon the church, Catechists and Protectors in particular. But your words echo loud in our hearts as our hallways. Some in our number will see the slynth as the chosen of chosen, and if I speak to them first, everyone else will take it as Shekhinah's will. Which, arguably, it would be. Tell the slynth that the Mechanimists will have them.

strings.string: 高塔之地接纳难民，这不是头一回了，=name=，不过须知，这对教会是一桩负担，尤其是对教理师与护卫者。然而你的话在我们心中回响，一如在我们的廊庑间回响。我们当中有人会视斯林斯人为选民中的选民，我若先去与他们说，旁人便会当作是舍金纳的旨意。这么说来，倒也未必不是。去告诉斯林斯人，机神教徒收容他们。

string.ID: You have my thanks, Sheba.

strings.string: 多谢你，舍芭。

string.ID: I mean no slight to these slynth folk, =name=, but the Stiltgrounds have hosted refugees before and it is a substantial burden upon our stewards. Our resources and space are scant, and I must request that you find another home for them. May the Kasaphescence shine upon them, and you, in this endeavor.

strings.string: 我并无轻慢斯林斯人之意，=name=，只是高塔之地此前已接纳过难民，这对我们的执事是一桩沉重的负担。我们的资源与地方都有限，我只能请你另为他们寻一处家园。愿圣化现眷照他们，也眷照你在此事上的努力。

string.ID: =name=, bless you. Have you brought tidings of the slynth?

strings.string: =name=，愿你蒙福。你可带来了斯林斯人的消息？

string.ID:
Praise be to Shekhinah, =name=, your slynth friends are hard workers and quick learners!
I can't help but feel a bit concerned at their ethic, and who in the church might take advantage of it. I hope to foster an interest in reading in them if I can, before they are taught incuriosity. Perhaps a book club?

strings.string:
赞美舍金纳，=name=，你那些斯林斯朋友勤勉肯干，学得又快！
我不由得有些担心他们的这份勤勉，也担心教会中有谁会利用它。我若能做到，愿趁他们尚未被教得不再好奇之前，培养他们读书的兴趣。或许可以办个读书会？

string.ID: My thanks, chronicler.

strings.string: 多谢，编年史官。

string.ID:
Live and learn, =name=.
The slynth are settling in as folk do. I see some flank the Priests and Catechists with empty eye, but some have proven hungry for knowledge. I have established a weekly Canticle study group, and its numbers grow each meeting.
Praise be to Shekhinah for this meeting, =name=.

strings.string:
且生且学，=name=。
斯林斯人正渐渐安顿，一如常人。我见有些人目光空洞地侍立在祭司与教理师身侧，也有些人证明了自己渴求知识。我设了一个每周一次的圣歌研习小组，每次聚会人数都在增加。
为这次相聚赞美舍金纳，=name=。

string.ID: My thanks again, chronicler.

strings.string: 再次多谢，编年史官。

string.ID: Oh, we're in but the first phase of its foundation. The church has amassed a splendid collection of scripts through the years. Glorious Shekhinah, praise be upon Him, gifted us with several caches. The eremites work day and night reproducing them in the scriptorium, and I have taken it upon myself to beseech travelers, for the rarest finds often come from the least likely places.

strings.string: 哦，我们才刚刚打下根基。教会多年来积攒了一批卓绝的经卷。荣耀的舍金纳，愿赞美归于祂，曾赐予我们数处藏匿的典籍。隐修士们日夜在抄经房里誊录，而我自己则担起了向旅人恳求的差事，因为最稀罕的发现，往往出自最意想不到的地方。

string.ID: I will donate a book.

strings.string: 我愿捐一本书。

string.ID: What use is a library in this salt den? Or in the marshes, strangled by wild plants and poisoned by the glow? Wouldn't a stash of vinereapers serve us better?

strings.string: 在这盐窟里，要藏书楼何用？或在被野草勒颈、被辉光毒害的沼泽里？囤一批藤镰不是更有益吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, chronicler.

strings.string: 且生且饮，编年史官。

string.ID:
You share the pessimism of my kin, and several of the priests as well. My heart hears you, but listen to my words, and maybe you will come to feel as I do.
To devalue wisdom is to devalue the Kasaphescence. She shines in the void, refracting light, illuminating those around her. So does the written wisdom of our elders.
The machinery of chromium is complex in its divinity. Don't we do a disservice to our Fathers when we remain ignorant of it, of our past, of our future? Don't we deserve the joy of knowing? Bless Eschelstadt II, first Child, for he believes as I do.

strings.string:
你与我的亲族一般悲观，几位祭司亦然。我的心听见了你，但请听我一言，或许你也会渐渐与我同感。
贬低智慧，便是贬低圣化现。她在虚空中闪耀，折射光芒，照亮周遭万物。我们先辈所留下的文字智慧，亦复如是。
铬的机枢，其神圣之处何等繁复。我们若对它、对我们的过去、对我们的未来一无所知，岂不是辜负了诸父？我们岂不配享知晓之乐？愿埃舍尔施塔特二世，首位圣子，蒙福，因他与我所信相同。

string.ID: I will donate a book.

strings.string: 我愿捐一本书。

string.ID: Where is the library?

strings.string: 藏书楼在哪里？

string.ID: Live and drink, chronicler.

strings.string: 且生且饮，编年史官。

string.ID: Peace and health in the light of the Star, pilgrim. Brood with me on the life of Resheph, if you are willing.

strings.string: 愿平安与健康在星辰之光中与你同在，朝圣者。你若愿意，与我一同默想利悉的一生吧。

string.ID: I am.

strings.string: 正是。

string.ID: Who is Resheph?

strings.string: 利悉是谁？

string.ID: What's inside the tent?

strings.string: 帐篷里有什么？

string.ID: Live and drink, priest.

strings.string: 且生且饮，祭司。

string.ID:
A spiritual patron of kith and kin, who did so much for us, and who leads me and others like me to the path of healing. For, above all, he was a healer. He dressed the wounds of the sick and rid the land of the plagues of the Gyre.
He was also a sultan, but he was the last sultan. He unbricked the walls of monocracy so we could pick berries in the orchards they hid.

strings.string:
他是亲族眷属的灵性守护者，为我们做了许多，也引领我与同道走上疗愈之路。因为他首先是一位医者。他包扎病人的伤口，驱除回旋的瘟疫。
他也是一位苏丹，但是最后一位苏丹。他拆去独裁的砖墙，我们才得以到墙后隐藏的果园里采摘浆果。

string.ID: I've more to ask.

strings.string: 我还有别的要问。

string.ID: Live and drink, priest.

strings.string: 且生且饮，祭司。

string.ID:
A quiet shrine to the Coiled Lamb, centuries old. Tucked away here, outside the marble parapets and cloaked in the dust of time, it's lost to those who'd sneer at the veneration of Resheph over other fathers.
Step inside and voice a prayer, if you are willing.

strings.string:
一座静谧的盘羔神龛，历数百年。它隐于此处，在大理石女墙之外，蒙着岁月的尘埃，那些嘲笑人们尊崇利悉胜过其他诸父的人，是找不到它的。
你若愿意，请入内祈祷。

string.ID: I've more to ask.

strings.string: 我还有别的要问。

string.ID: Live and drink, priest.

strings.string: 且生且饮，祭司。

string.ID: Don't breathe in too deep, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I've set some glue to dry.

strings.string: 别吸得太深，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我有些胶水正晾着。

string.ID: Live and drink, but please do it elsewhere. I fear spills.

strings.string: 且生且饮，不过请到别处去。我怕洒了。

string.ID: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Feel free to examine my books closely.

strings.string: 你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=。尽可细看我的书。

string.ID: Please inspect only the quality of the letters. I am not a librarian.

strings.string: 只请检视字迹的品质。我可不是藏书楼的管事。

string.ID: These books can weather the salt and jungle alike.

strings.string: 这些书经得起盐地，也经得起丛林。

string.ID: I assure you, the smell fades once the glue is dry.

strings.string: 我保证，胶干之后气味便散了。

string.ID: I've books for trade, if you're interested.

strings.string: 我有书可供交易，你若有意。

string.ID: Everything I sell is the product of many hours of toil.

strings.string: 我卖的每一样，都是多少个时辰辛劳的成果。

string.ID: Come closer, so I can see your face.

strings.string: 凑近些，让我看清你的脸。

string.ID: Ink runs in my very veins, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 墨水就流在我的血管里，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: If you're looking to read, I have what you need.

strings.string: 你若想读书，我这儿有你要的。

string.ID: Please be gentle with the parchment.

strings.string: 请对羊皮纸温柔些。

string.ID: Do be quick, =player.formalAddressTerm=, as I've much work to do.

strings.string: 请快些，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我活儿多着呢。

string.ID: Live and drink, reader.

strings.string: 且生且饮，读者。

string.ID: Come here. No, closer. Don't mind the bees, they rarely sting.

strings.string: 过来。不，再近些。别管蜜蜂，它们很少蜇人。

string.ID: Don't be afraid to approach. The bees rarely sting.

strings.string: 别怕，走近些。蜜蜂很少蜇人。

string.ID: Care for some beejuice?

strings.string: 来点蜂汁吗？

string.ID: Drink a dram of honey every morning, Slog itself couldn't make you sick.

strings.string: 每天早晨喝一打兰蜂蜜，连斯洛格本人也没法让你生病。

string.ID: You know, bees communicate by dancing. Got a whole language.

strings.string: 你知道吗，蜜蜂靠跳舞交流。自成一套语言呢。

string.ID: Without bees, all life in Qud would eventually die.

strings.string: 没有蜜蜂，卡德所有的生灵终将死绝。

string.ID: Bees are smarter than you think. They got that hive mind, see.

strings.string: 蜜蜂比你想的聪明。它们有蜂巢的群体意识，懂吧。

string.ID: I eat honey matz every morning and I ain't been sick in decades.

strings.string: 我每天早晨吃蜂蜜马茨，几十年没生过病了。

string.ID: We'd all be dead without bees, you know.

strings.string: 你要知道，没有蜜蜂，咱们都得死。

string.ID: Use your gadgets hard, don't you? I can fix them.

strings.string: 器械使得挺狠，是吧？我能修。

string.ID: I can repair, recharge, and identify whatever you have! Within reason.

strings.string: 修理、充能、鉴定，你手上的物件我都包了！在情理之内的话。

string.ID: If you've got anything you can't make heads or tails of it, give it here.

strings.string: 若有什么东西你摸不着头脑，拿来给我。

string.ID: You've got to respect a machine. Machines bite harder than any croc.

strings.string: 对机器须存敬畏。机器咬起人来，比鳄鱼还狠。

string.ID: You a maker?

strings.string: 你是个造物人？

string.ID: Take out what you've busted and I'll jury-rig it for a fair price.

strings.string: 把坏掉的拿出来，我给你凑合着修好，价钱公道。

string.ID: Need scrap?

strings.string: 要废料吗？

string.ID: You get used to the nicks and burns, after years working with spark and solder.

strings.string: 与火花和焊锡厮磨多年，磕碰与烫伤也就惯了。

string.ID: They say some folks can talk to machines. I say we all can, if we listen right.

strings.string: 都说有些人能与机器交谈。依我看，人人都能，只要听得对。

string.ID: My fees for battery charging depend how empty the battery is when you bring it to me.

strings.string: 我给电池充能的价钱，要看你送来时电池空到什么地步。

string.ID: Absolutely no refunds or returns on scrap.

strings.string: 废料概不退换，绝无例外。

string.ID: I would prefer not to interrupt this task long.

strings.string: 我不愿此事被打断太久。

string.ID: How my joints ache! Buy something to justify my pain.

strings.string: 我这一身关节痛啊！买点东西，也不枉我受这份罪。

string.ID: Unfinished schematics are obviously not for sale. Everything else is.

strings.string: 未完成的图纸自然不卖。其余皆可出售。

string.ID: Disturb the trash if you must, but do not touch any of my papers.

strings.string: 要翻垃圾便翻，但我的纸稿，一张都不许碰。

string.ID: Are you a tinker? Surely I have something you wish to build.

strings.string: 你是修补匠吗？我这里想必有你愿造之物。

string.ID: If you've the wits to build, I've got something you want.

strings.string: 你若有造物的才智，我这儿正有你想要的东西。

string.ID: I have lost much to my dedication. Help me gain anew, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 我为这份事业舍弃良多。请助我重有所得，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: So help me, Argent Fathers, if someone has changed the order of my papers...

strings.string: 银辉诸父在上，若有人动了我这些纸稿的次序……

string.ID: Please, =player.formalAddressTerm=, buy a schematic. I'm sure it will be of use to you.

strings.string: 请买一份图纸吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我敢说它对你有用。

string.ID: Even if you can't make a thing now, you could gain the insight later.

strings.string: 纵然你眼下造不出，日后也许会有所悟。

string.ID: I've the cure for what ails you.

strings.string: 你的病痛，我这里有药可治。

string.ID: You don't look so good. You need more yuckwheat and honey in your diet.

strings.string: 你气色不佳。饮食里该多添些苦麦和蜂蜜。

string.ID: In the market for a tonic, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Spend water now or blood later, your choice.

strings.string: 要买补药吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？今日花水，来日流血，任你挑选。

string.ID: Prickly-boons and yuckwheat for trade.

strings.string: 刺果与苦麦，可供交易。

string.ID: Cook your meals with yuckwheat if you feel sick. Catch a disease early enough and you can kill it.

strings.string: 身子不适，就用苦麦烹食。病症趁早，便可除根。

string.ID: If you came for the humble pie, you had best not have led any mind-hunters here.

strings.string: 你若是来吃“谦卑馅饼”的，最好别把什么猎心者引到这儿来。

string.ID: "Ease the pain, addle the brain." Be careful when you chew witchwood bark.

strings.string: “止痛，乱脑。”嚼巫木树皮时可得当心。

string.ID: Don't eat the hoarshrooms too fast, now.

strings.string: 霜菇别吃得太急。

string.ID: Have you got enough tonics?

strings.string: 补药备足了吗？

string.ID: Got a fungal infection? You'll want one of my spray bottles to apply the cure.

strings.string: 染了真菌感染？你需要我的一只喷瓶来施药。

string.ID: Get your hands on the Corpus Choliys for disease and fungus cures.

strings.string: 想治疾病与真菌，就弄到一册《科珀斯·科利斯》。

string.ID: I've the cure for what ails you.

strings.string: 你的病痛，我这里有药可治。

string.ID: You don't look so good. You need more yuckwheat and honey in your diet.

strings.string: 你气色不佳。饮食里该多添些苦麦和蜂蜜。

string.ID: Cook your meals with yuckwheat if you feel sick. Catch a disease early enough and you can kill it.

strings.string: 身子不适，就用苦麦烹食。病症趁早，便可除根。

string.ID: "Ease the pain, addle the brain." Be careful when you chew witchwood bark.

strings.string: “止痛，乱脑。”嚼巫木树皮时可得当心。

string.ID: Best not leave town without some bark and bandages, wayfarer.

strings.string: 出城前最好带些树皮与绷带，行路人。

string.ID: Live and drink. Keeping well, I hope?

strings.string: 且生且饮。身子可还康健？

string.ID: How are you feeling today, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 今日觉得如何，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: Moon and sun, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Keeping healthy?

strings.string: 月与日，=player.formalAddressTerm=。可还康健？

string.ID: I tell you, =player.formalAddressTerm=, my recipes come from years of experience. There's none the like.

strings.string: 我说啊，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我这些食谱出自多年的经验，无人能比。

string.ID: Finest food for parasangs! Finest food in Qud! Recipes and samples!

strings.string: 数帕兰桑之内最好的美食！卡德最好的美食！食谱与试吃，应有尽有！

string.ID: I will share my food-secrets with you, =player.formalAddressTerm=, if you're willing to make it worth my while.

strings.string: 我愿把烹饪的秘诀传授于你，=player.formalAddressTerm=，只要你肯让我觉得值得。

string.ID: Do you cook, =player.formalAddressTerm=? So long as you aren't the type to throw whatever local debris you find in the pot, I have wares for you.

strings.string: 你做菜吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？只要你不是那种见着什么本地杂物都往锅里扔的人，我这儿就有货给你。

string.ID: Not a word of lie, I studied under a chef who studied under Agate Severance Star herself. That's why my recipes are the best.

strings.string: 句句不虚，我曾师从一位大厨，而那位大厨师从玛瑙诀别之星本人。所以我的食谱才是最好的。

string.ID: Try my recipe. You'll believe =player.reflexive= to be judging the Carbide Chefs in the Kitchen Heptagon itself.

strings.string: 试试我的食谱。你会以为=player.reflexive=正坐在厨房七角堂里，评判碳化物厨师们的手艺。

string.ID: Cookbooks are best named from the heart. Those who ridicule the name of a cookbook have lost their sense of wonder.

strings.string: 食谱集的名字，当发自内心而取。嘲笑食谱集名字的人，早已失去了惊奇之心。

string.ID: Live and eat, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 且生且食，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 且生且饮，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Smell a bit strong? That's how you know it's good.

strings.string: 味道有点冲？这才说明是好东西。

string.ID: You can preserve almost anything. Al... most.

strings.string: 几乎什么都能腌藏。几……乎。

string.ID: Preserved ingredients cook better, safer.

strings.string: 腌藏过的食材，烹来更佳，也更稳妥。

string.ID: Everything I sell is safe to eat as it is.

strings.string: 我卖的东西，一概可以直接入口。

string.ID: Welcome, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Need vittle?

strings.string: 欢迎，=player.formalAddressTerm=。要口粮吗？

string.ID: Crave a bit of salt, =player.formalAddressTerm=, or a load of salt?

strings.string: 想来点盐吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=，还是来一大堆盐？

string.ID: Nothing sadder than a cookfire and nothing to cook over it.

strings.string: 没有比这更凄凉的了：灶火燃着，却无物可烹。

string.ID: Are you a chef, =player.formalAddressTerm=? My vittles are of the highest quality.

strings.string: 你是厨子吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？我的吃食都是上等货色。

string.ID: Nourishment for the road, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 要不要备些路上的口粮，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 问候你，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Live and drink deeply, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 且生且痛饮，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, please come in.

strings.string: 啊，=player.formalAddressTerm=，请进。

string.ID: My wares are sweet and strong, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Care to try them?

strings.string: 我的酒香甜而醇烈，=player.formalAddressTerm=。可愿尝尝？

string.ID: Tell me, =player.formalAddressTerm=, is there any sight more sad than a hookah tent without wine?

strings.string: 告诉我，=player.formalAddressTerm=，还有什么景象，比没有酒的水烟帐更凄凉？

string.ID: Wine, cheese, bread. =player.FormalAddressTerm=, tell me, is there anything else you truly need?

strings.string: 酒、奶酪、面包。=player.FormalAddressTerm=，告诉我，你当真还需要别的什么吗？

string.ID: The kipper and I both know that the finest ingredient is time.

strings.string: 腌鱼师与我都明白：最上乘的原料，是时间。

string.ID: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Try some rose wine? One rose is fair, but as you may know from hanging around the Stiltgrounds, five is death.

strings.string: 问候你，=player.formalAddressTerm=。尝尝玫瑰酒如何？一朵玫瑰尚且可爱，但你在高塔之地逛过便知，五朵便是死亡。
液体……

string.ID: Aren't they beautiful, =player.formalAddressTerm=? The bottles, the phials, the light shining through them.

strings.string: 不美吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？瓶子，小管，还有透过它们闪耀的光。

string.ID: Live and drink, but not everything. Some things you don't drink.

strings.string: 且生且饮，但不可什么都饮。有些东西是不能喝的。

string.ID: Is there any state of form so fine as a liquid?

strings.string: 还有什么形态，比液体更精妙？

string.ID: Pouring, decanting, collecting, mixing. I adore my calling.

strings.string: 倾倒、滗清、收集、调和。我热爱我的天职。

string.ID: If it flows, I desire it. You should too, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 凡能流动的，我都渴慕。你也该如此，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Do you ever stop and think about fluids? Are they not divine?

strings.string: 你可曾停下来想想流体？它们岂不神圣？

string.ID: Someday I will plumb the depths of Bethesda Susa, that I may meet the Alchemist.

strings.string: 总有一日，我要探到毕士大-苏萨的深处，去会一会那位炼金术士。

string.ID: Live and drink, and collect, and combine...

strings.string: 且生且饮，且集且合……

string.ID: Hold, aristocrat! I have wares to claim your interest.

strings.string: 留步，贵族！我有货物，定能引你注目。

string.ID: My implants are acquired peaceably, I assure you.

strings.string: 我的植入体都是和平取得的，我向你保证。

string.ID: How becoming you look, Aristocrat! But you could be more becoming.

strings.string: 你看上去多么得体，贵族！但还可以更得体。

string.ID: Tire of your legs? Arms? Hands? See what I have that fits you.

strings.string: 厌倦了你的腿？手臂？双手？来看看我这儿有什么适合你。

string.ID: Luxury internal adornments for the discerning Aristocrat.

strings.string: 为眼光独到的贵族准备的奢华体内饰物。

string.ID: No additional sterilisation required, of course.

strings.string: 当然，无需另行消毒。

string.ID: Quality implants for sale at reasonable prices!

strings.string: 优质植入体，价格公道，欢迎选购！

string.ID: You strike me as an Aristocrat who knows the value of artisanal organs.

strings.string: 我看你像是个懂得手工脏器价值的贵族。

string.ID: I recommend everything I carry. Not all at once, of course.

strings.string: 我携带的每一样，我都推荐。当然，不必一次全要。

string.ID: Hope you'll "becoming" back, ha ha.

strings.string: 盼你再来“化身”，哈哈。

string.ID: Live and drink, Aristocrat.

strings.string: 且生且饮，贵族。

string.ID: Kill anyone valuable?

strings.string: 杀过什么值钱的人没有？

string.ID: You look dangerous. Ever go hunting for parts?

strings.string: 你看着挺凶险。可曾去猎过零件？

string.ID: Got guts?

strings.string: 有内脏吗？

string.ID: Can you imagine sticking one of these things inside you? Disgusting.

strings.string: 你能想象把这玩意儿塞进自己身体里吗？恶心。

string.ID: I've plenty water if you've got implants to sell.

strings.string: 你要是有植入体卖，我水多的是。

string.ID: Always check becoming nook shelves for parts.

strings.string: 化身龛的架子上，记得总要翻翻有没有零件。

string.ID: Y'ain't peeled open any Sons or Daughters, have you?

strings.string: 你没剖开过什么诸子诸女吧？

string.ID: Less I know about where my stock comes from, the better.

strings.string: 我越不知道货从哪儿来，越好。

string.ID: I'll still take parts you ain't washed off, it's fine.

strings.string: 你没洗掉的零件我照样收，无妨。

string.ID: If you can butcher a boar, you can do the same to a man. Just ain't meat you're looking for.

strings.string: 你既能宰野猪，就能宰人。只是你要找的可不是肉。

string.ID: My best customers don't ask questions. My best stock asked too many.

strings.string: 我最好的主顾从不多问。我最好的货，问得太多了。

string.ID: Need something to complete your ensemble, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 需要点什么来凑齐你这身行头吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: With a good hat, =player.formalAddressTerm=, you'll last longer in the salt sun.

strings.string: 戴上一顶好帽子，=player.formalAddressTerm=，你在盐日下能撑得更久。

string.ID: Peruse my wares, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Adorn your head or heads.

strings.string: 请细看我的货品，=player.formalAddressTerm=。为你的头，或你的诸头，添些装饰。

string.ID: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Care for a new topper?

strings.string: 问候你，=player.formalAddressTerm=。想换顶新帽吗？

string.ID: You need a new hat, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Or a helmet, if that's the life you lead.

strings.string: 你该换顶新帽了，=player.formalAddressTerm=。或者换顶头盔，若你过的是那种日子。

string.ID: If you're passing through baboon country, you'll want to protect your head, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 若要途经狒狒之地，你可得护好脑袋，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 且生且饮，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Hello, hello, =player.formalAddressTerm=, let's get your weary feet covered.

strings.string: 你好，你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=，让我们给你疲惫的双脚穿上点什么。

string.ID: Come in, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and let me 'shoe' you around, ha ha!

strings.string: 请进，=player.formalAddressTerm=，让我带你“鞋”程一番，哈哈！

string.ID: Boots! Shoes! Slippers! Sabatons! How would you prefer to cover your feet, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 靴子！鞋子！拖鞋！铁足甲！你想怎样包裹双脚，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: Even as high-quality as my products are, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I don't suggest you go walking in the fracti to test them out.

strings.string: 纵然我的货如此上乘，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我也不建议你走进断裂体丛里去试穿。

string.ID: Anything you need to ask 'a boot', =player.FormalAddressTerm=? Just a little cobbler's joke, there.

strings.string: 有什么要向“靴”问的吗，=player.FormalAddressTerm=？不过是句鞋匠的小玩笑罢了。

string.ID: Hot sands out there, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Is your footwear protecting you?

strings.string: 外头沙子滚烫，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你的鞋子护得住你吗？

string.ID: Hello, =player.formalAddressTerm=! Care to be shod?

strings.string: 你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=！想穿双鞋吗？

string.ID: Walk a few parasangs in my shoes, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and you'll wonder how you ever did otherwise.

strings.string: 穿上我的鞋走几帕兰桑吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=，你会奇怪自己先前怎能忍受别的。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 且生且饮，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Please, =player.formalAddressTerm=, do come in. Take your time browsing my wares.

strings.string: 请进，=player.formalAddressTerm=，不必着急，慢慢看我的货品。

string.ID: Welcome, =player.formalAddressTerm=, to the sole bastion of class in this wretched place.

strings.string: 欢迎，=player.formalAddressTerm=，来到这凄惨之地唯一的体面堡垒。

string.ID: Please knock the sand from your feet, =player.formalAddressTerm=. It gets everywhere.

strings.string: 请把脚上的沙子磕掉，=player.formalAddressTerm=。这东西无孔不入。

string.ID: Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I can certainly help you.

strings.string: 啊，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我定能帮你。

string.ID: How may I clothe you, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 要我如何为你着装，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: Now, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I know you must have an eye for fashion, if you're here.

strings.string: 好了，=player.formalAddressTerm=，你既然来了这里，想必是有眼光的。

string.ID: Oh dear. Who dressed you, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Let me help you, please.

strings.string: 哎呀。是谁给你穿成这样的，=player.formalAddressTerm=？请让我来帮你。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 且生且饮，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: {{emote|*silent nod*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*默默点头*}}

string.ID: Careful. It's hot.

strings.string: 小心。烫。

string.ID: =player.FormalAddressTerm=. Need protection?

strings.string: =player.FormalAddressTerm=。要护具吗？

string.ID: Be quick about it, eh?

strings.string: 麻利点，嗯？
你好。
嗯？

string.ID: I've got my eye on you.

strings.string: 我可盯着你呢。

string.ID: Leather, ring, and plate, to keep you alive.

strings.string: 皮甲、环甲、板甲，保你性命。

string.ID: Don't get near the hearth.

strings.string: 别靠近炉膛。

string.ID: =player.FormalAddressTerm=. Live and drink.

strings.string: =player.FormalAddressTerm=。且生且饮。

string.ID: Hand-coats for sale! Spare your digits the indignity of early removal!

strings.string: 手套出售！别让你的手指蒙受过早离体之辱！

string.ID: Best protect your hands, =player.formalAddressTerm=. You don't know how much you need them until a madpole takes one.

strings.string: 最好护住双手，=player.formalAddressTerm=。直到被狂蝌蚪咬掉一只，你才知道有多离不开它们。

string.ID: Light gloves, heavy gloves, gauntlets. Don't let your hands go bare, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 轻手套、重手套、护手甲。别让双手光着，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: One size fits all, =player.formalAddressTerm=. If I sell it to you, it fits.

strings.string: 一码通用，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我卖给你的，就合你的手。

string.ID: How do I get my gloves so supple? I'll never tell.

strings.string: 我的手套怎会这般柔韧？我可不会说。

string.ID: Moving on soon, =player.formalAddressTerm=? My gloves and gauntlets need no maintenance, so finely are they crafted.

strings.string: 很快要上路了吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？我的手套与护手甲无需保养，做工就是这般精良。

string.ID: Live and eat, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 且生且食，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 且生且饮，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: You can't go wrong with my slugspitters, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 我的吐弹枪绝不会让你失望，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Guns, guns, guns! Don't they just make you smile?

strings.string: 枪，枪，枪！它们不就是让人展颜一笑吗？

string.ID: =player.FormalAddressTerm=, I tell you: there is no defense like a good, and distant, offense.

strings.string: =player.FormalAddressTerm=，我告诉你：没有什么防御，胜得过一次漂亮而遥远的进攻。

string.ID: Ahh, I love the smell of cordite. You know, that sulfury smell? Accelerants make a fine perfume, if you ask me.

strings.string: 啊，我爱无烟火药的气味。你知道的，那股硫磺味？依我看，助燃剂是上好的香水。

string.ID: You know, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I once had an traveler from Yawningmoon tell me my shop smelled of home. Now I want to visit! Hah!

strings.string: 你知道吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我曾听一位来自月启之地的旅人说，我这铺子闻着像故乡。如今我倒想去看看了！哈！

string.ID: May you find adequate cover and more loot than you can carry, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 愿你觅得足够的掩体，和多得拿不动的战利品，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: I used to be a wayfarer like you, =player.formalAddressTerm=, but old wounds slow you down. Cherish the time while you have it.

strings.string: 我从前也是个像你这样的行路人，=player.formalAddressTerm=，可旧伤会拖慢脚步。趁还有时间，且珍惜吧。

string.ID: I wish I could allow you to test my wares in the shop, =player.formalAddressTerm=, but walk a parasang in any direction and you'll find a target.

strings.string: 我倒想让你在店里试试我的货，=player.formalAddressTerm=，但朝哪个方向走一帕兰桑，都能找到靶子。

string.ID: Might not want to touch anything on the workbenches, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 工作台上的东西，最好都别碰，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Live, drink, and shoot, =player.formalAddressTerm=, in whichever order you like.

strings.string: 且生，且饮，且开枪，=player.formalAddressTerm=，先后次序随你喜欢。

string.ID: Need something blown up, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 需要炸点什么吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: Grenades do no good sitting in a pack. Don't forget to use them.

strings.string: 手雷躺在背包里可没用。别忘了用它们。

string.ID: =player.FormalAddressTerm=, there is little you can't solve with a well-thrown grenade... as long as you don't stand too close.

strings.string: =player.FormalAddressTerm=，没有什么难题，是一枚投得好的手雷解决不了的……只要你别站得太近。

string.ID: Defoliant and fungicide are perfectly safe, but you may wish to avoid breathing too deeply all the same.

strings.string: 落叶剂与杀菌剂十分安全，不过你还是别吸得太深为好。

string.ID: Can I serve you something explosive, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 要我给你上点会爆炸的东西吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: You'll be back, =player.formalAddressTerm=, provided you don't blow =player.reflexive= up.

strings.string: 你会再来的，=player.formalAddressTerm=，只要你别把=player.reflexive=炸飞。

string.ID: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Be careful with my wares as you peruse them.

strings.string: 问候你，=player.formalAddressTerm=。细看我的货品时，请多加小心。

string.ID: How is your throwing arm, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Barring that, do you feel lucky?

strings.string: 你的投掷臂力如何，=player.formalAddressTerm=？不行的话，你觉得自己运气好吗？

string.ID: It's a dangerous job, =player.formalAddressTerm=, but well worth it.

strings.string: 这是份危险的差事，=player.formalAddressTerm=，但很值得。

string.ID: The vintners say that 'one rose is fair, but five is death'. I can sell you blossoms that mean death no matter the number.

strings.string: 酒商们说“一朵玫瑰尚且可爱，五朵便是死亡”。我卖你的花，无论几朵，都意味着死亡。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 且生且饮，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: There's a shape in every stone waiting to be brought out.

strings.string: 每块石头里，都有一个等待被雕出的形状。

string.ID: If you bend the light just so, it frays into brilliance.

strings.string: 将光折得恰到好处，它便绽散成璀璨。

string.ID: I can wait years for the inspiration to craft another figurine. I have before.

strings.string: 为下一尊小像寻得灵感，我可以等上数年。从前就等过。

string.ID: What manner of jewel are our eyes, to skew light into thought?

strings.string: 我们的眼睛是何等宝石，竟能把光扭作思绪？

string.ID: Enter, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and behold my jewels and figurines.

strings.string: 请进，=player.formalAddressTerm=，来赏我的珠玉与小像。

string.ID: Uncrafted jewels and metals buy and sell for the same cost, but my art's price tag is up to me.

strings.string: 未经雕琢的宝石与金属，买卖同价；而我的作品标价几何，全凭我意。

string.ID: Every statuette is a tribute, of a kind, but not every tribute is received well.

strings.string: 每一尊雕像，皆是某种供奉，只是并非每份供奉都能蒙人欣纳。

string.ID: Wouldn't these make a fine conversation piece for a water ritual?

strings.string: 这些岂不是水礼上绝佳的谈资？

string.ID: Beautiful baubles and gleaming gemstones over here!

strings.string: 美丽的饰物与闪亮的宝石，尽在这边！

string.ID: A well-polished and well-picked gem, no matter how rough, is as beautiful a work of art as any figurine.

strings.string: 一枚琢磨得当、挑选得宜的宝石，纵然粗朴，其美亦不逊于任何小像。

string.ID: Lean in close to see the detail. No, don't touch.

strings.string: 凑近些看细节。不，别碰。

string.ID: Within my gemstones there burns a brighter fire than in some hearts.

strings.string: 我的宝石之内，燃着比某些人心中更明亮的火。

string.ID: Water-wealth means nothing if you cannot carry it. Need jewels?

strings.string: 水财若携不动，便是空谈。要珠宝吗？

string.ID: Friend, I have precious metals and jewels to adorn or trade.

strings.string: 朋友，我这儿有贵金属与珠玉，可佩可易。

string.ID: Raw metals and gems buy and sell for a fixed water-cost.

strings.string: 生金属与宝石，以固定的水价买卖。

string.ID: Come, wanderer, change some of that heavy water for a pocketful of riches.

strings.string: 来吧，漂泊者，把你那沉甸甸的水，换成满袋的财富。

string.ID: Water Barons don't adorn themselves with water, after all.

strings.string: 毕竟，水权贵族可不会拿水来装点自己。

string.ID: {{emote|*mumbling*}} ...exceeding mass thresholds, perhaps a ganglionic teleprojector fitted with suspensors...

strings.string: {{emote|*喃喃自语*}}……质量超出阈值，或许配上悬浮器的神经节远投仪……

string.ID: Oh, I didn't notice you there. That's because I was ignoring you.

strings.string: 噢，我没留意到你在那儿。那是因为我一直在无视你。

string.ID: {{emote|*mumbling*}} ...waste heat from the thermo cask? Or centrifugal extraction to the p-density of sunslag...

strings.string: {{emote|*喃喃自语*}}……热力桶的废热？还是离心抽取到日渣的p密度……

string.ID: Where can I find a cave?

strings.string: 哪里能找到洞穴？

string.ID: I'm not interested.

strings.string: 我没兴趣。

string.ID: There are caves everywhere, you dolt! Scoop the surface of the marsh, or head on east to the rust wells, or wander into the Desert for all I care...

strings.string: 洞穴到处都是，你这蠢货！舀一舀沼泽的地表，或往东去锈井，或者闯进沙漠去，随你的便……

string.ID: I will return with your knickknack.

strings.string: 我会把你的小玩意儿带回来。

string.ID: I'm not interested.

strings.string: 我没兴趣。

string.ID: You're standing in my light! What do you want?

strings.string: 你挡着我的光了！有何贵干？

string.ID: Here is your knickknack.

strings.string: 这是你的小玩意儿。

string.ID: Nothing. I will return with your knickknack.

strings.string: 没事。我会把你的小玩意儿带回来。

string.ID: Ah, mmm, hmmm. Are you a useful one, after all? Go fetch me another!

strings.string: 啊，嗯，哼。你终究是个有用的人？去，再给我取一件来！

string.ID: If I must.

strings.string: 只好如此了。

string.ID: Ah, mmm, hmmm. Are you a useful one, after all? Go fetch me another!

strings.string: 啊，嗯，哼。你终究是个有用的人？去，再给我取一件来！

string.ID: Here is your knickknack.

strings.string: 这是你的小玩意儿。

string.ID: If I must.

strings.string: 只好如此了。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Argyve whistles.*}}
Impressive, you! Maybe you're fit to poke around my workshop and swap scrap with me. I have been wanting another apprentice. So unfortunate about Skref, what with the disembowelment and all. Take a seat, there.

strings.string:
{{emote|*阿尔吉夫吹了声口哨。*}}
了不得，你！也许你配得上在我的工坊里翻翻找找，与我互换废料。我早就想再收个学徒了。斯克雷夫那事真是不幸，被开膛破肚什么的。坐，坐那儿。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Argyve raises both eyebrows.*}}
Now, to screw the nut on the bolt with an explanation! I'm on the cusp, you see. A grand discovery. The Weirdwire Conduit is near assembled, and once it is, we'll be able to chat with anyone... in instant time! from here to the Yd Freehold. But before I can finish, I need wire. As much as you can find... at least two hundred feet. You should be able to scavenge it from the rust wells.

strings.string:
{{emote|*阿尔吉夫双眉高扬。*}}
好，现在，该给螺栓配上螺母，把话说明白了！你瞧，我正处在紧要关头。一项伟大的发现。怪线导管已近组装完成，一旦完成，我们就能与任何人交谈……瞬息之间！从这里直到伊德自由领。可在完工之前，我需要线。越多越好……至少两百英尺。你应该能从锈井那边捡到。

string.ID: I'll fetch you your wire.

strings.string: 我会给你取线来。

string.ID: I'm not interested.

strings.string: 我没兴趣。

string.ID: The wire! Give it to me!

strings.string: 线！给我！

string.ID: Take the wire.

strings.string: 收下这线。

string.ID: I don't have enough yet.

strings.string: 我还没凑够。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Argyve hoots*}}
Yes, yes! Beautiful wire! -oh, before I forget, I repaired an old recoiler for you. Use it whenever you wish to hop back to Joppa quickly. Now, give me a few moments to attach the wire...

strings.string:
{{emote|*阿尔吉夫放声欢呼*}}
对，对！漂亮的线！——噢，趁我没忘，我给你修好了一只旧返程器。你想快速回约帕时，随时用它。现在，给我几分钟，让我把线接上……

string.ID: I will return.

strings.string: 我会回来。

string.ID: It's working! Genius! Genius! Noise in the static- I hear it! I hear!... what's this? What *is* that? Wait...

strings.string: 通了！天才！天才！静电里有噪音——我听见了！我听见了！……这是什么？那*是*什么？等等……

string.ID: It's repeating itself...

strings.string: 它在重复自己……
