string.ID: {{emote|*Argyve mumbles to himself for several minutes.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*阿尔吉夫对自己嘟囔了好几分钟。*}}

string.ID: Apprentice! Come, here! Something strange is occurring. The Conduit is picking up a signal, some sort of repeating transmission. I cannot decipher it, however. I lack cryptogull eggs and, well, never you mind! I have a great task for you, my apprentice. Do you accept it?

strings.string: 学徒！过来，这儿！出了怪事。导管截获了一个信号，某种重复的传输。可我无法破译。我缺密码鸥蛋，而且，嗐，不必管它！我有一桩大任务交给你，我的学徒。你接不接？

string.ID: Can I know what it is?

strings.string: 我能知道那是什么吗？

string.ID: -yes. You must seek out Barathrum the Old, the eldest and wisest tinker alive. He lives with his followers the Barathrumites under the arch of Grit Gate to the northeast, in the jungle-strangled ruins of Qud. He will know what to make of the signal.

strings.string: ——能。你须去寻老巴拉斯鲁姆，在世的修补匠中最年长、最睿智者。他与门下的巴拉斯鲁姆派，住在东北方砂砾门的拱门之下，那是卡德被丛林勒缠的废墟。他会知道这信号作何解。

string.ID: Who are these Barathrumites?

strings.string: 这些巴拉斯鲁姆派是什么人？

string.ID: I require no further information. I will go.

strings.string: 无需多问。我这就去。

string.ID: Disciples of Barathrum. Mostly urshiib, like their mentor- quilled albino bears who prefer their candle-dim caves to the sun-salted surface of the jungle. A thousand years ago Barathrum and his kin crossed the Homs Delta into the rusting heart of Qud. He has spent centuries peeling the chrome shells off time's artifacts in his workshop. If he cannot decipher the signal, no one can.

strings.string: 巴拉斯鲁姆的门徒。多为乌尔希卜人，与他们的导师一样——生着尖刺的白化熊，宁爱烛光般昏暗的洞穴，也不爱丛林中盐日灼烤的地表。千年之前，巴拉斯鲁姆与族人渡过霍姆斯三角洲，进入卡德锈蚀的心脏。他在自己的工坊里，花了数百年，剥取时间遗物的铬壳。若连他都破译不了这信号，那便无人能破译了。

string.ID: I accept the task, Argyve.

strings.string: 我接下这任务，阿尔吉夫。

string.ID: I must think on this.

strings.string: 我得考虑一下。

string.ID: Farewell, Argyve.

strings.string: 再会，阿尔吉夫。

string.ID:
Splendid! Perfect! Let me record the signal to disk, which you'll need to guard with your life, I'm afraid.
I'll rig up a droid scrambler for you, too. You see, the Barathrumites have programmed a troupe of waydroids to guard the approach to Grit Gate. With the scrambler, you'll needn't worry about them. Wait there.

strings.string:
妙极！绝佳！让我把信号录到磁盘上，恐怕你得拿命来守着它。
我也给你装一个机器人干扰器。你瞧，巴拉斯鲁姆派设定了一队路径机器人，守卫通往砂砾门的路径。有了干扰器，你就无需担心它们。在那儿等着。

string.ID: {{emote|*Argyve mumbles to himself for several minutes.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*阿尔吉夫对自己嘟囔了好几分钟。*}}

string.ID: Here you are. Now, go! Off with you! May you live long enough to do my bidding. Away, away!

strings.string: 给，拿去。现在，走吧！快走！愿你活得够长，好听我差遣。去，去！

string.ID: Farewell, Argyve.

strings.string: 再会，阿尔吉夫。

string.ID: The Barathrumites say I must plumb a cave called Golgotha before joining them.

strings.string: 巴拉斯鲁姆派说，加入他们之前，我须先探一处名叫各各他的洞穴。

string.ID: Argyve, I am no apprentice. The Barathrumites call me =factionaddress:Barathrumites= now.

strings.string: 阿尔吉夫，我已不是学徒了。巴拉斯鲁姆派如今称我为=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。

string.ID: Need anything, Argyve?

strings.string: 阿尔吉夫，需要什么吗？

string.ID: Farewell, Argyve.

strings.string: 再会，阿尔吉夫。

string.ID: My apprentice! What?

strings.string: 我的学徒！什么事？

string.ID: Who are the Barathrumites again?

strings.string: 巴拉斯鲁姆派到底是什么人来着？

string.ID:
Did they, now? Well you're not MY =factionaddress:Barathrumites=!
Grit Gate is not Joppa, you pridesome solder-nail, and in this house you are apprentice still.
Now, what did you want? Be quick!

strings.string:
他们这么说了，是吗？哼，你可不是我的=factionaddress:Barathrumites=！
砂砾门可不是约帕，你这自负的焊钉，在这屋里你仍是学徒。
好了，你想要什么？快说！

string.ID:
-what?
No, no, I'm far too engrossed to see to your curiosity. I'm sure the Barathrumites have something for you to do.

strings.string:
——什么？
不，不，我正全神贯注，没空理会你的好奇心。想必巴拉斯鲁姆派有事让你去做。

string.ID:
Welcome to Grit Gate. I am Otho, Barathrum's steward. I apologize for the manner of our introduction, but we must take precautions. Qud is a very unforgiving place.
You demonstrate tremendous promise to have returned from Golgotha with such inexperience. Take this firearm as your reward. It bears the mark of our finest gunsmith, Sparafucile. Take this bracelet, as well.
Return when you are ready to discuss the signal.

strings.string:
欢迎来到砂砾门。我是奥索，巴拉斯鲁姆的管事。我为我们这样的见面方式致歉，但我们不得不有所防备。卡德是个不留情面的地方。
你竟能这般毫无经验地从各各他归来，足见前途无量。收下这把火器作为奖赏。它带有我们最出色的枪匠斯帕拉富奇莱的印记。这只手镯，也请收下。
待你准备好商议信号之事，再来见我。

string.ID: Thank you. I will return.

strings.string: 谢谢。我会回来。

string.ID:
Welcome to Grit Gate. I am Otho, Barathrum's steward. I apologize for the manner of our introduction, but we must take precautions. Qud is a very unforgiving place.
I am pleased to see that you've returned with the waydroid, though you still know little of the dangers you bear. Take this firearm as your reward. It bears the mark of our finest gunsmith, Sparafucile.
Return when you are ready to discuss the signal.

strings.string:
欢迎来到砂砾门。我是奥索，巴拉斯鲁姆的管事。我为我们这样的见面方式致歉，但我们不得不有所防备。卡德是个不留情面的地方。
见你带着路径机器人归来，我很欣慰，尽管你对自己所冒的凶险仍知之甚少。收下这把火器作为奖赏。它带有我们最出色的枪匠斯帕拉富奇莱的印记。
待你准备好商议信号之事，再来见我。

string.ID: Thank you. I will return.

strings.string: 谢谢。我会回来。

string.ID:
Welcome to Grit Gate. I am Otho, Barathrum's steward. I apologize for the manner of our introduction, but we must take precautions. Qud is a very unforgiving place.
You are worthy to study with us. Take these.
Return when you are ready to discuss the signal.

strings.string:
欢迎来到砂砾门。我是奥索，巴拉斯鲁姆的管事。我为我们这样的见面方式致歉，但我们不得不有所防备。卡德是个不留情面的地方。
你有资格与我们一同研习。收下这些。
待你准备好商议信号之事，再来见我。

string.ID: Thank you. I will return.

strings.string: 谢谢。我会回来。

string.ID:
It takes more than a willing spirit to be trusted here, wayfarer.
Prove your worth and bring us a waydroid, and we will have more to speak of.

strings.string:
光有一腔热忱，还不足以在此获得信任，行路人。
证明你的价值，给我们带一台路径机器人来，那时才有更多可谈。

string.ID: Are you ready to discuss the signal?

strings.string: 你准备好商议信号之事了吗？
愿意。
还没有。

string.ID:
The signal is a repeat transmission being broadcast from an unknown source. =V0tinkeraddendum= One of our tinkers, {{m|Q Girl}}, discovered it while rigging a long wave detector. Unfortunately, it's encrypted, and we do not have the means here to decrypt it. You may be of some help in this matter, however.
We've long known the location of a fully functioning {{W|baetyl}} within the bowels of the great hall {{C|Bethesda Susa}}. The Mechanimists have consecrated the site around it and built a temple there. Q Girl claims to have developed a means to decrypt the signal, but she needs the computing power of the baetyl. If you can infiltrate the Mechanimist compound, you may be able to engage the baetyl and decode the signal.

strings.string:
这信号是一段重复的传输，来源不明。=V0tinkeraddendum=我们的一位修补匠，{{m|Q女孩}}，在装配长波探测器时发现了它。可惜它被加密了，而我们这里没有破译的手段。不过，你或许能在此事上帮上忙。
我们早已知道，大厅{{C|毕士大-苏萨}}的腹地之中，有一块功能完好的{{W|圣石}}。机神教徒已将其周围之地奉为圣地，并在那里修建了神殿。Q女孩声称她已想出破译信号的办法，但需要借圣石的运算之力。若你能潜入机神教徒的营地，或许就能启动圣石，译出信号。

string.ID: What is a baetyl?

strings.string: 圣石是什么？

string.ID:
They are antique stones located in certain places deep within the caverns of Qud. We believe they are some sort of hyper-advanced machines built by the Eaters. Often one claims to possess a sentience of its own. However, most of them have gone haywire in the eons since their creation; it is rare indeed to discover one whose circuitry is wholly uncorroded.
The Mechanimists worship this one as an idol, and they will protect it at all costs. You will need to find a way through their host to the baetyl itself.
Do you believe you can accomplish this task?

strings.string:
它们是古老的石头，位于卡德洞穴深处的某些地方。我们相信，它们是食者所造的某种超高级机器。往往有一块自称拥有自己的灵识。然而，自造出以来的亘古岁月里，多数都已失常；能找到一块线路丝毫未锈的，实属罕见。
机神教徒将这一块奉为偶像崇拜，必将誓死护卫。你得设法穿过他们的人马，抵达圣石本身。
你相信自己能完成此事吗？

string.ID: Yes, I do.

strings.string: 是的，我相信。

string.ID: I must think on this task.

strings.string: 我须思量一下此事。

string.ID:
Good, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Speak to {{m|Q Girl}} in the workshop. She'll encode her instructions for the baetyl onto a copy of the disk.
There's one more thing. The baetyl is located beneath the ancient cryobarrios of the Eaters. Time has worked to erode the mechanisms that contain their cryogenic mist. That freezing vapor billows out of the chambers freely now, cooling the entire cavern. You will want to procure warm clothing to protect =player.reflexive=.
The spoils of the Mechanimists are yours to keep. Remember, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=, Barathrum will look kindly upon your service.

strings.string:
好，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。去工坊找{{m|Q女孩}}。她会把对圣石的指令编码到磁盘的副本上。
还有一事。圣石位于食者古老的冷冻街区之下。岁月侵蚀了盛放其冷冻雾气的机关。那冻寒的蒸汽如今自由涌出，使整座洞穴都寒冷刺骨。你得设法弄些保暖的衣物，护住=player.reflexive=。
机神教徒的战利品，你尽可留着。记住，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=，巴拉斯鲁姆会善待你的效劳。

string.ID: I will return with the data, Steward.

strings.string: 我会带着数据回来，管事。

string.ID: Luck be with you in the lair of Bethsaida, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=.

strings.string: 愿幸运伴你踏入伯赛大的巢穴，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。

string.ID: I will return with the data, Steward.

strings.string: 我会带着数据回来，管事。

string.ID: You return. Have you succeeded in decoding the signal?

strings.string: 你回来了。信号破译成功了吗？
愿意。

string.ID: Well done, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Present the disk.

strings.string: 干得好，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。把磁盘交上来。

string.ID: [Give Otho the disk]

strings.string: [把磁盘交给奥索]

string.ID: I must bring the decoded signal to Barathrum immediately. Return in a few hours. By then I'll have discussed our next course of action with Barathrum and will have further instructions for you.

strings.string: 我须立刻把译出的信号带给巴拉斯鲁姆。几个时辰后再来。到时我已与巴拉斯鲁姆商议过下一步行动，会有进一步的指示给你。

string.ID: As you say, steward.

strings.string: 遵命，管事。

string.ID: =factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=, I have no further instructions for you yet. Return soon.

strings.string: =factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=，我暂时还没有进一步的指示。过会儿再来。

string.ID: As you say, steward.

strings.string: 遵命，管事。

string.ID: =name=, I've brought the decoded signal to Barathrum, and he's finished musing on it. We have fresh instructions for you, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Are you ready to hear them?

strings.string: =name=，我已把译出的信号带给巴拉斯鲁姆，他已沉思完毕。我们有新的指示给你，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。你准备好听了吗？
愿意。

string.ID:
Barathrum needs you for an undertaking of great importance. You must journey to {{C|Omonporch}} far to the north. There the Spindle stretches from earth to sky. Unfortunately, a troublesome merchant from the Consortium of Phyta has relocated there and declared xerself Earl of Omonporch. We need you to broker a deal so that we may lease control of the Spindle. Failing that, you'll need to dispose of the self-appointed Earl.
Be careful on your approach to Omonporch, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. So far east into the reaches of Qud, the Putus Templar lie in wait.

strings.string:
巴拉斯鲁姆需要你去办一件至关重要的事。你须远行至北方遥远的{{C|奥蒙门廊}}。纺锤在那里自地通天。不巧，植体联盟的一位麻烦商人已迁居该地，并宣布自己为奥蒙门廊伯爵。我们需要你出面斡旋，好让我们租得纺锤的控制权。若不成，你就得除掉这位自封的伯爵。
接近奥蒙门廊时务必小心，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。在卡德极东之地，普图斯圣殿骑士团正伺机而动。

string.ID: Who are the Putus Templar?

strings.string: 普图斯圣殿骑士团是什么人？

string.ID: What is the purpose of this?

strings.string: 这有何用意？

string.ID: I will secure the Spindle for Barathrum.

strings.string: 我会为巴拉斯鲁姆夺下纺锤。

string.ID: I must think on this task.

strings.string: 我须思量一下此事。

string.ID:
The Putus Templar, or the Sons and Daughters, as they call themselves, are an order of knights who claim descendancy from the Eaters, the ancient folk who wrought the chrome halls of Qud. Beware them, for while they despise all mutants, they harbor a special malice for Barathrum.
Take care that you do not find =player.reflexive= inside one of their slave pens.

strings.string:
普图斯圣殿骑士团，或称他们自号的诸子诸女，是一个骑士修会，自称是食者的后裔——食者即那远古之民，铸造了卡德的铬钢大厅。提防他们，因为他们憎恶一切变种人，对巴拉斯鲁姆更怀有特别的恶意。
当心别让=player.reflexive=落入他们的奴隶囚栏之中。

string.ID: What is the purpose of this?

strings.string: 这有何用意？

string.ID: I will secure the Spindle for Barathrum.

strings.string: 我会为巴拉斯鲁姆夺下纺锤。

string.ID: I must think on this task.

strings.string: 我须思量一下此事。

string.ID:
That will be revealed to you in due time.
Do not forget your place, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=.

strings.string:
时机到了，自会让你知晓。
别忘了你的本分，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。

string.ID: Who are the Putus Templar?

strings.string: 普图斯圣殿骑士团是什么人？

string.ID: I will secure the Spindle for Barathrum.

strings.string: 我会为巴拉斯鲁姆夺下纺锤。

string.ID: I must think on this task.

strings.string: 我须思量一下此事。

string.ID:
It's as I feared, =name=. Grit Gate is being assailed. The Putus Templar must have followed you back from Omonporch.
Let us use the precious little time we have before they arrive to prepare our defenses.

strings.string:
不出我所料，=name=。砂砾门正遭围攻。普图斯圣殿骑士团定是从奥蒙门廊一路尾随你而来。
趁他们抵达之前仅有的一点时间，让我们备好防御。

string.ID: What can I do?

strings.string: 我能做什么？

string.ID: Go to the mainframe room and scan the shale surrounding Grit Gate for anomalies. Now, =name=!

strings.string: 去主机室，扫描砂砾门周围的页岩，查找异常。快去，=name=！

string.ID: I'll go now.

strings.string: 我这就去。

string.ID:
With the chrome key card I gave you, you now have access to our power grid. There are chain laser emplacements and force projectors across the enclave. Use Ereshkigal's reconnaissance to decide which defenses to enable. You can also broadcast an overclock command or activate Rodanis Y by interfacing with Ereshkigal.
Be mindful of the amperage draw, though. If you overdraw the grid, you could cause brownouts.
Act quickly, =name=! The Templar near us even as we speak.

strings.string:
有了我交给你的铬钢钥匙卡，你现在可以接入我们的电网。整座营地遍布连锁激光炮位与力场发射器。借埃列什基伽勒的侦察来决定启用哪些防御。你也可以通过与埃列什基伽勒对接，广播超频指令，或启动罗达尼斯Y。
不过要留意电流负载。若电网过载，便会引发电压骤降。
要快，=name=！圣殿骑士说话间已近在咫尺。

string.ID: I'll do my best to defend Grit Gate.

strings.string: 我会竭力保卫砂砾门。

string.ID: That rumbling... what was it? An explosion? Hmm...

strings.string: 那隆隆声……是什么？爆炸吗？嗯……

string.ID: What are you thinking, Otho?

strings.string: 你在想什么，奥索？

string.ID:
Grave thoughts, =name=. Listen to me now. Take this key card, go to Ereshkigal's room, and-- oh, that's the mainframe. It's what she prefers to be called.
Go to her room, access Ereshkigal, and scan the shale surrounding the enclave for anomalies. I've asked her to ready her sensors.
Update me with what you learn. You may use the intercom in the northeast corner of Ereshkigal's room to deliver your update.
Go, quickly! I'd soon be disabused of my fears.

strings.string:
心事沉重，=name=。听好。拿上这张钥匙卡，去埃列什基伽勒的房间，然后——噢，那是主机。她更喜欢这个称呼。
去她的房间，接入埃列什基伽勒，扫描营地周围的页岩，查找异常。我已请她备好传感器。
把你查到的告诉我。你可以用埃列什基伽勒房间东北角的对讲机汇报。
快去！我宁愿我的忧惧被证明是多虑。

string.ID: I'll go now.

strings.string: 我这就去。

string.ID:
You can still activate our defenses, =name=. There are chain laser emplacements and force projectors across the enclave. Use Ereshkigal's reconnaissance to decide which defenses to enable. You can also broadcast an overclock command or activate Rodanis Y by interfacing with Ereshkigal.
Be mindful of the amperage draw, though. If you overdraw the grid, you could cause brownouts.

strings.string:
你仍可启用我们的防御，=name=。整座营地遍布连锁激光炮位与力场发射器。借埃列什基伽勒的侦察来决定启用哪些防御。你也可以通过与埃列什基伽勒对接，广播超频指令，或启动罗达尼斯Y。
不过要留意电流负载。若电网过载，便会引发电压骤降。

string.ID: I'll do my best to defend Grit Gate.

strings.string: 我会竭力保卫砂砾门。

string.ID: Have you secured the Spindle yet?

strings.string: 你夺下纺锤了吗？

string.ID: Yes, the Spindle is ours.

strings.string: 是的，纺锤已归我们。

string.ID: No, not yet.

strings.string: 不，还没有。

string.ID: Leave me alone for a moment, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. I have duties to attend.

strings.string: 容我独处片刻，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。我还有职责在身。

string.ID: I will return later, Otho.

strings.string: 我稍后再来，奥索。

string.ID: That is sterling news, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. I'll go inform Barathrum straightaway.

strings.string: 这消息再好不过，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。我这就去禀告巴拉斯鲁姆。

string.ID:
Furthermore, I spoke with Barathrum. He praised your handling of the Earl of Omonporch, and he thanks you for the bravery you exhibited in defending Grit Gate.
The attack today reminds us: for too long have we put our faith in the isolation of our guild and the preoccupations of the Putus Templar. The looming threat of another attack impels Barathrum to accelerate his plans, and with them, your position in our guild.
You are raised to Disciple, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Barathrum wishes to speak with you immediately.

strings.string:
此外，我已与巴拉斯鲁姆谈过。他称赞你处置奥蒙门廊伯爵的手段，也感谢你在保卫砂砾门时所显的勇气。
今日之袭提醒了我们：我们太久以来，都把信心寄托在本会的与世隔绝，与普图斯圣殿骑士团的无暇他顾之上。又一次攻击的阴影迫使巴拉斯鲁姆加快谋划，连带你在本会中的地位也随之提升。
你已晋升为门徒，=player.formalAddressTerm=。巴拉斯鲁姆希望立刻与你一谈。

string.ID: He wishes to speak to me? Barathrum himself?

strings.string: 他想见我？巴拉斯鲁姆本人？

string.ID:
I spoke with Barathrum. He praised your handling of the Earl of Omonporch, and he thanks you for the bravery you exhibited in defending Grit Gate.
The attack today reminds us: for too long have we put our faith in the isolation of our guild and the preoccupations of the Putus Templar. The looming threat of another attack impels Barathrum to accelerate his plans, and with them, your position in our guild.
You are raised to Disciple, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Barathrum wishes to speak with you immediately.

strings.string:
我已与巴拉斯鲁姆谈过。他称赞你处置奥蒙门廊伯爵的手段，也感谢你在保卫砂砾门时所显的勇气。
今日之袭提醒了我们：我们太久以来，都把信心寄托在本会的与世隔绝，与普图斯圣殿骑士团的无暇他顾之上。又一次攻击的阴影迫使巴拉斯鲁姆加快谋划，连带你在本会中的地位也随之提升。
你已晋升为门徒，=player.formalAddressTerm=。巴拉斯鲁姆希望立刻与你一谈。

string.ID: He wishes to speak to me? Barathrum himself?

strings.string: 他想见我？巴拉斯鲁姆本人？

string.ID: He wishes to speak to me? Barathrum himself?

strings.string: 他想见我？巴拉斯鲁姆本人？

string.ID: Yes, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Take this key and follow the stairs down to his study. He awaits.

strings.string: 是的，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。拿上这把钥匙，沿阶而下，便是他的书斋。他在等你。

string.ID: Thank you, Otho.

strings.string: 多谢，奥索。

string.ID: Yes, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Follow the stairs down to his study. He awaits.

strings.string: 是的，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。沿阶而下，便是他的书斋。他在等你。

string.ID: Thank you, Otho.

strings.string: 多谢，奥索。

string.ID: I am busy, wayfarer. Please talk to Mafeo in the trade square if you need something.

strings.string: 我正忙，行路人。若有所需，请去贸易广场找马费奥。

string.ID:
=factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=! You have my deepest gratitude. Few =player.personTerm|pluralize= could have defended Grit Gate so deftly.
Now, give me time to assess our losses and consult with Barathrum. Return soon.

strings.string:
=factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=！我对你深怀感激。能如此娴熟地保卫砂砾门的=player.personTerm|pluralize=，寥寥无几。
现在，容我清点损失，并与巴拉斯鲁姆商议。稍后再来。

string.ID: Live and drink, Otho.

strings.string: 且生且饮，奥索。

string.ID: Given the circumstances, this is a remarkable lack of destruction. Your defense of Grit Gate was first-class, =name=.

strings.string: 事已至此，毁损之轻，实属难得。你对砂砾门的保卫堪称一流，=name=。

string.ID: Thank you for the update, Otho.

strings.string: 谢谢你告知近况，奥索。

string.ID: Much was lost, but such is what I expected. Once again, thank you for efforts, =name=.

strings.string: 损失惨重，但也在意料之中。再次感谢你的努力，=name=。

string.ID: Thank you for the update, Otho.

strings.string: 谢谢你告知近况，奥索。

string.ID: Such tremendous loss. I wonder if more could have been done to prevent it.

strings.string: 如此巨大的损失。我不禁想，是否本可做得更多以防患于未然。

string.ID: Thank you for the update, Otho.

strings.string: 谢谢你告知近况，奥索。

string.ID: Yes, =name=?

strings.string: 何事，=name=？

string.ID: Live and drink, steward.

strings.string: 且生且饮，管事。

string.ID: Be straightforward, disciple. You mean to ask if we will house them.

strings.string: 说得直白些，门徒。你是想问，我们可愿收容他们。

string.ID: I am uncertain that you know the enormity of what you ask me, =name=. Nonetheless, I cannot deny what you have done for our order. These slynth must be tested as you were, but should they show the mettle and drive set by your example, we will accept them as apprentices.

strings.string: 你可知所求之事何其重大，我实在存疑，=name=。然而你为本会所做的一切，我不能不认。这些斯林斯须如你当年那般受考验；若他们果真显出你所立之榜样的锐气与志向，我们便收他们为学徒。

string.ID: You have my thanks, Otho.

strings.string: 多谢你，奥索。

string.ID: You have grown bold beyond your station. What you have asked of us you have not earned. If you must ask again, become worthier first.

strings.string: 你已僭越本分了。你所求于我们的，你尚未挣得。若要再求，先使自己更配得上。

string.ID: Has this slynth situation been settled yet?

strings.string: 斯林斯这件事，可曾了结？

string.ID:
I did not expect to admit this, disciple, but the refugees have met my expectations. Like you, they have shown more than a willing spirit in work and curiosity both.
The slynth have promise, and you may have been right to bring them to us.

strings.string:
门徒，我本不愿承认，但这些难民已不负我所望。与你一样，他们无论在劳作还是求知上，都不止是肯用心而已。
斯林斯前途可期，你将他们带来，或许是对的。

string.ID: My thanks, Otho.

strings.string: 多谢你，奥索。

string.ID:
Live and drink, disciple.
You will be pleased to know that the slynth have proven themselves worthy of apprentice status. They will reside here for as long as they uphold and serve the tenets of our order.

strings.string:
且生且饮，门徒。
你会乐于得知：斯林斯已证明自己配得学徒之名。只要他们恪守并奉行本会的信条，便可在此长住。

string.ID: My thanks again, Otho.

strings.string: 再谢你，奥索。

string.ID:
It's as I feared, =name=. Grit Gate is being assailed. The Putus Templar must have followed you back from Omonporch.
Let us use the precious little time we have before they arrive to prepare our defenses.

strings.string:
不出我所料，=name=。砂砾门正遭围攻。普图斯圣殿骑士团定是从奥蒙门廊一路尾随你而来。
趁他们抵达之前仅有的一点时间，让我们备好防御。

string.ID: What can I do?

strings.string: 我能做什么？

string.ID:
With the chrome key card I gave you, you now have access to our power grid. There are chain laser emplacements and force projectors across the enclave. Use Ereshkigal's reconnaissance to decide which defenses to enable. You can also broadcast an overclock command or activate Rodanis Y by interfacing with Ereshkigal.
Be mindful of the amperage draw, though. If you overdraw the grid, you could cause brownouts.
Act quickly, =name=! The Templar near us even as we speak.

strings.string:
有了我交给你的铬钢钥匙卡，你现在可以接入我们的电网。整座营地遍布连锁激光炮位与力场发射器。借埃列什基伽勒的侦察来决定启用哪些防御。你也可以通过与埃列什基伽勒对接，广播超频指令，或启动罗达尼斯Y。
不过要留意电流负载。若电网过载，便会引发电压骤降。
要快，=name=！圣殿骑士说话间已近在咫尺。

string.ID: I'll do my best to defend Grit Gate.

strings.string: 我会竭力保卫砂砾门。

string.ID: {{emote|*loud static*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*嘈杂的静电声*}}

string.ID: Quetzal! Who are you, stranger?

strings.string: 魁札尔！陌生人，你是谁？

string.ID: I must be going.

strings.string: 我该走了。

string.ID: It's time to fight, =name=. Are you with me?

strings.string: 该开战了，=name=。你与我同心吗？

string.ID: I am.

strings.string: 正是。

string.ID: Quetzal, quetzal, quetzal! Welcome to the workshop, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 魁札尔，魁札尔，魁札尔！欢迎来到工坊，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Barathrum asked me to deliver your blueprints to Pax Klanq.

strings.string: 巴拉斯鲁姆托我把你的蓝图交给帕克斯·克朗克。

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Q Girl?

strings.string: Q女孩，你感觉到那阵隆隆声了吗？

string.ID: What does 'quetzal' mean?

strings.string: “魁札尔”是什么意思？

string.ID: Your hair is a quasar of red ochre and indigo.

strings.string: 你的头发是赭红与靛蓝交织的类星体。

string.ID: Do you like my goggles?

strings.string: 你喜欢我的护目镜吗？

string.ID: There must be a hundred gadgets here. What are you working on?

strings.string: 这里少说也有上百件小玩意。你在忙什么？

string.ID: Otho informs me that you have a method for decoding the signal. Can you encode your instructions for the baetyl onto this disk?

strings.string: 奥索告诉我，你有办法解码那道信号。你能把给圣石的指令编入这张碟片吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.

strings.string: 且生且饮，修补匠。

string.ID: Yikes! Yes! The intensity was too great to be the result of one of my experiments. What was it, I wonder?

strings.string: 哎呀！是的！那震动太猛烈了，绝不可能是我哪次实验搞出来的。我在想，那究竟是什么？

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.

strings.string: 且生且饮，修补匠。

string.ID: It's a word I say out of excitement. Sort of a semantic extension of the feeling I get when I see a quetzal. Oh, a quetzal is a pretty bird in the trogon family. I tend to incorporate things I like into my idiolect.

strings.string: 那是我兴奋时说的词。算是我见到魁札尔时的那种感受，在语义上的延伸。哦，魁札尔是一种美丽的鸟，属咬鹃科。我总爱把喜欢的东西编进自己的个人语言里。

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.

strings.string: 且生且饮，修补匠。

string.ID: Quetzal! Thank you, thank you. What a poetic metaphor! You're a regular Shakesprig, aren't you?

strings.string: 魁札尔！谢谢，谢谢你。多诗意的比喻！你简直是个地地道道的莎士比芽，对不对？

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.

strings.string: 且生且饮，修补匠。

string.ID: Yes, yes, yes. They are so quetzal!

strings.string: 是的，是的，是的。它们太魁札尔了！

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.

strings.string: 且生且饮，修补匠。

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.

strings.string: 且生且饮，修补匠。

string.ID: I do, brave friend. I'll imprint them now.

strings.string: 有的，勇敢的朋友。我这就把它们刻进去。

string.ID: Thank you, Q Girl.

strings.string: 谢谢你，Q女孩。

string.ID: Here they are, brave friend. Good luck!

strings.string: 给，勇敢的朋友。祝你好运！

string.ID: Thank you, Q Girl.

strings.string: 谢谢你，Q女孩。

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile lifts one brow, giving you a wary look.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱扬起一道眉，警觉地打量着你。*}}

string.ID: I'll be going.

strings.string: 我走了。

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile gives =pronouns.possessive= carbine a once-over and gives you a resolute nod.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱将=pronouns.possessive=的卡宾枪端详了一遍，向你坚定地点了点头。*}}

string.ID: *nod back*

strings.string: *点头回应*

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile gives you a resolute nod.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱向你坚定地点了点头。*}}

string.ID: *nod back*

strings.string: *点头回应*

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile nods.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱点了点头。*}}

string.ID: Greetings, Sparafucile.

strings.string: 问候你，斯帕拉富奇莱。

string.ID: *nod back*

strings.string: *点头回应*

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile raises one long-fingered hand in greeting.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱抬起一只修长手指的手，向你致意。*}}

string.ID: Do you know anything about Bethesda Susa?

strings.string: 你对毕士大-苏萨可有所知？

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Sparafucile?

strings.string: 斯帕拉富奇莱，你感觉到那阵隆隆声了吗？

string.ID: Have you ever met Pax Klanq?

strings.string: 你见过帕克斯·克朗克吗？

string.ID: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我必须穿过食者之墓，进入明冥。

string.ID: What do you think of Klanq's presence?

strings.string: 你对克朗克在此驻留，作何看法？

string.ID: Your carbine is as fine an instrument as I have ever wielded.

strings.string: 你的卡宾枪，是我所用过的最精良的器具之一。

string.ID: Your pistol is as fine an instrument as I have ever wielded.

strings.string: 你的手枪，是我所用过的最精良的器具之一。

string.ID: You are a bear of few words.

strings.string: 你真是只寡言的熊。

string.ID: Are you happy living in this cave, away from the sun and open sky?

strings.string: 你住在这洞穴里，远离阳光与开阔的天空，心里可舒坦？

string.ID: Live and drink, harm-artisan.

strings.string: 且生且饮，兵匠。

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile frowns. After several moments of paper-shuffling, he presents you with a charcoal drawing depicting a gelatinous creature in the shape of a gumdrop. Sketches below depict the ooze enveloping a bipedal figure, then falling through the floor.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱皱起眉头。翻了好一阵纸堆之后，他递给你一幅炭笔画：画中是一团胶状的生物，形如一颗软糖。下方的草图里，那团黏液裹住一个两足的人形，随后穿过地面坠落下去。*}}

string.ID: An ooze that can melt through the floor...

strings.string: 一种能融穿地面的黏液……

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile furrows his brow for a few moments, then shakes his head, sighs, and offers you a shrug. He puts a paw on your shoulder and squeezes.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱蹙眉片刻，随即摇了摇头，叹了口气，耸耸肩。他把一只爪子搭在你肩上，捏了捏。*}}

string.ID: Fair enough, friend.

strings.string: 也罢，朋友。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Sparafucile instructs you to wait, and spends a minute or so rifling through the papers and scraps scattered across =pronouns.possessive= workbench. At last =pronouns.subjective= produces a graphite sketch of a cylinder, an expertly-rendered specular revealing its surface to be shiny like glass. The detail of the cylinder's contents are indistinct and dark, but somehow menacing.*}}
{{emote|*Sparafucile points to the glass and makes a breaking motion, then draws a thumb across =pronouns.possessive= throat.*}}

strings.string:
{{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱示意你稍候，随即花了一分钟左右，在=pronouns.possessive=散落着纸张与碎片的工作台上翻找。最后，=pronouns.subjective=拿出一幅石墨素描：画的是一只圆柱体，镜面反光描绘得极为精到，显出其表面光亮如玻璃。柱内之物的细节模糊而幽暗，却不知为何透着凶险。*}}
{{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱指着那玻璃，做了个打碎的动作，又用拇指在=pronouns.possessive=喉间划过。*}}

string.ID: I'll have to be careful of... glass tubes?

strings.string: 我得提防……玻璃管？

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile gives you a warm smile and a firm nod. Pressing both pointers to their respective thumbs, =pronouns.subjective= taps these finger-circles together before =pronouns.possessive= chest and rotates both hands in place until the smallest of =pronouns.possessive= long fingers touch. Finally, =pronouns.subjective= gestures toward the other Barathrumites working at their stations.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱向你露出温暖的笑容，坚定地点了点头。=pronouns.subjective=将两只食指分别按上各自的拇指，在=pronouns.possessive=胸前让这两个指环相互轻碰，又原地转动双手，直至=pronouns.possessive=最小的那两根长指相触。最后，=pronouns.subjective=朝其他在各自岗位上忙碌的巴拉斯鲁姆派众人比了比。*}}

string.ID: I don't understand. Can you explain aloud?

strings.string: 我不明白。你能出声解释一下吗？

string.ID: You are happy because you are with your family?

strings.string: 你快乐，是因为与家人在一起？

string.ID: If I might change the subject...

strings.string: 容我换个话题……

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile smiles. =pronouns.Subjective= raises a flat hand to =pronouns.possessive= chin and lowers it in your direction.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱笑了。=pronouns.Subjective=抬起一只平展的手放到=pronouns.possessive=下巴处，再朝你的方向放下。*}}

string.ID: You are welcome.

strings.string: 不必客气。

string.ID: {{emote|*With a nod, Sparafucile waits for you to continue, keeping =pronouns.possessive= eyes focused on your lips.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱点点头，等你继续，=pronouns.possessive=的目光始终盯着你的嘴唇。*}}

string.ID: Why are you staring at my mouth?

strings.string: 你为什么盯着我的嘴？

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile places a closed fist over =pronouns.possessive= mouth, then taps =pronouns.possessive= ear, then muzzle with one long finger.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱将一只握拳的手按在=pronouns.possessive=嘴上，随后用一根长指轻点=pronouns.possessive=的耳朵，再点点口鼻。*}}

string.ID: You are... unable to hear or speak.

strings.string: 你……听不见，也说不出话。

string.ID: {{emote|*Smiling a bit, Sparafucile nods.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱微微一笑，点了点头。*}}

string.ID: Is your condition a result of your work?

strings.string: 你这病症，是因你的工作而起的吗？

string.ID: Yet you are an expert in your field? How inspiring!

strings.string: 可你在自己的行当里依然是行家？真令人振奋！

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile shakes =pronouns.possessive= head.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱摇了摇=pronouns.possessive=头。*}}

string.ID: Your condition is lifelong?

strings.string: 你这病症是终身的？

string.ID: Thank you for your clarity and patience, tinkerfriend.

strings.string: 多谢你的明白与耐心，修补匠友。

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile nods.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱点了点头。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile nods grimly.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱神色严峻地点了点头。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*With a small smile of gratitude, Sparafucile taps his chin with a flat hand and lowers it toward you like a drawbridge.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱含着一丝感激的浅笑，用平展的手轻敲下巴，再向你放下，宛如一座吊桥。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile averts =pronouns.possessive= gaze and heaves a tired sigh.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱移开=pronouns.possessive=目光，疲惫地叹了口气。*}}

string.ID: I merely asked...

strings.string: 我不过是问问……

string.ID: I apologize for my carelessness.

strings.string: 我疏忽了，抱歉。

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile gives you a wan smile and a thumbs-up.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱向你露出一抹苍白的笑，竖起拇指。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*=pronouns.Subjective= nods slowly, smirking.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*=pronouns.Subjective=缓缓点头，嘴角带着嘲弄的笑意。*}}

string.ID: Is... there any advice you can give me about going to meet him?

strings.string: 去见他之前……你可有什么建议给我？

string.ID: So anyway...

strings.string: 总之……

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile shrugs, still smirking.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱耸耸肩，仍旧带着嘲弄的笑。*}}

string.ID: Let us speak of other things.

strings.string: 我们谈点别的吧。

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile stares at you as if you have grown an additional, substantially uglier head, which you have not.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱盯着你，仿佛你多长了一个丑得多的脑袋——而你并没有。*}}

string.ID: I'll... be going then.

strings.string: 那……我走了。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Sparafucile makes an 'L' shape with both hands, thumbs facing down and fingers pointed toward one another, before flipping both hands so =pronouns.possessive= thumbs face up. =pronouns.Subjective= then raises a closed fist to =pronouns.possessive= mouth, thumb out, and mimes drinking from it.*}}
{{emote|*This done, =pronouns.subjective= nods once more and turns back to =pronouns.possessive= work.*}}

strings.string:
{{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱双手比出“L”形，拇指朝下、手指相对，随后翻转双手，使=pronouns.possessive=拇指朝上。=pronouns.Subjective=接着将一只握拳的手举到=pronouns.possessive=嘴边，拇指外翘，作饮水状。*}}
{{emote|*做完这些，=pronouns.subjective=再点了点头，转身继续=pronouns.possessive=手头的活计。*}}

string.ID:
Oh. Are you lost, =player.formalAddressTerm=?
I don't mind that you're here, but I was not expecting anyone.

strings.string:
哦。你迷路了吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？
你在这儿我倒不介意，只是没想到会有人来。

string.ID: Is this it, I wonder?

strings.string: 我在想，这就是了吗？

string.ID: Not today.

strings.string: 今天不了。

string.ID: What do you think of Klanq's visit?

strings.string: 你对克朗克来访一事，有何看法？

string.ID: Good to see you, Iseppa. Let's chat.

strings.string: 见到你真好，伊赛帕。我们聊聊吧。

string.ID:
I don't know.
Klanq's opacity is alluring, frustrating, and dangerous. Like Klanq, my thoughts on Klanq evade easy explanation.
What you build together will be amazing. Craft well.

strings.string:
我不知道。
克朗克的晦暗不明，既诱人，又恼人，也危险。我对克朗克的想法，也像克朗克一样，难以轻易说清。
你们合力造出的东西，必定惊人。好好造吧。

string.ID: Well, I should go. Live and drink.

strings.string: 嗯，我该走了。且生且饮。

string.ID:
These are the final chapters of this story, =name=, and likely of many stories more too.
It will be well to see the other side of all this, one way or another.

strings.string:
这是这段故事的最后几章了，=name=，恐怕也是许多别的故事的最后几章。
无论结局如何，能看到这一切的彼岸，总是好的。

string.ID: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我必须穿过食者之墓，进入明冥。

string.ID: Let's talk, Iseppa.

strings.string: 我们谈谈吧，伊赛帕。

string.ID: It will. Live and drink.

strings.string: 会的。且生且饮。

string.ID:
You're going to the Thin World? I confess to some measure of envy.
I have dreamt many times of disappearing into a cool ocean of information, shaking the cruft of my physical form from newly-freed quills. If that came of my waking life, would I then dream as chore-doing Iseppa in her chambers? Perhaps it's best I don't know.

strings.string:
你要去薄界？不瞒你说，我有几分羡慕。
我多次梦见自己消失于一片清凉的信息之海，从刚刚解脱的翎羽上抖落这副肉身的累赘。若这竟在醒时成真，那我是否会转而梦见自己仍是闺房中操持琐务的伊赛帕？或许还是不知道的好。

string.ID: Very well, Iseppa. Live and drink.

strings.string: 好吧，伊赛帕。且生且饮。

string.ID: Do you know anything about Bethesda Susa?

strings.string: 你对毕士大-苏萨可有所知？

string.ID: What do you know about Omonporch and the self-appointed Earl?

strings.string: 关于奥蒙门廊和那位自封的伯爵，你知道些什么？

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Iseppa?

strings.string: 伊赛帕，你感觉到那阵隆隆声了吗？

string.ID: Have you ever met Pax Klanq?

strings.string: 你见过帕克斯·克朗克吗？

string.ID: What are you working on, Iseppa?

strings.string: 伊赛帕，你在做什么？

string.ID: Are you tired?

strings.string: 你累了吗？

string.ID: I wish to know more about you.

strings.string: 我想多了解你一些。

string.ID: I do like you, Iseppa.

strings.string: 伊赛帕，我确实喜欢你。

string.ID: Thank you, =name=. I like you too.

strings.string: 谢谢你，=name=。我也喜欢你。

string.ID: What can you tell me about the other Barathrumites?

strings.string: 其他的巴拉斯鲁姆派众人，你能给我讲讲吗？

string.ID:
Bethesda Susa is an antipodal place, a gallery of life and death and the stages between. Its depths prolong life and end it early, remove life from the flow of days or return it.
It will seek to make you late. Take care you come back on time.

strings.string:
毕士大-苏萨是个对跖之地，是一座陈列生、死与二者之间诸般阶段的回廊。其深处既能延长生命，亦能使之早夭；既能将生命从光阴之流中抽走，亦能使之重返。
它会设法让你迟到。当心，要准时回来。

string.ID:
Though I adore the sights and smells of Omonporch, its bug problem becomes distracting.
If I'm to travel there, I always bring something they cannot zip away from.

strings.string:
奥蒙门廊的景致与气味，我固然喜爱，可那里的虫患实在叫人分心。
若要去那儿，我总会带上一件它们钻不走的东西。

string.ID:
Yes. That was not the voice of the caverns.
It feels like one of my nightmares come to life at last.

strings.string:
是的。那不是洞窟的声音。
仿佛我的某场噩梦终于成了真。

string.ID:
I have not.
I would, however, love to meet him. He seems a fun fungus.
But I daren't go. I fear the sludges.

strings.string:
没有。
不过，我倒是很想见见他。他看来是个有趣的菌子。
可我不敢去。我怕泥浆族。

string.ID: You fear sludge?

strings.string: 你怕泥浆？

string.ID: I see.

strings.string: 我明白了。

string.ID:
I fear sludges, the kind you may no longer describe with 'some'. Born of the ancient stuff of existence, possessed of malice and wanting nothing more than to eat whatever they can, and they can eat whatever. It is even worse when they drink.
Take care with them.

strings.string:
我怕的是泥浆族，那种再不能用“些许”来形容的泥浆。它们生自太古的存在之质，怀着恶意，别无所求，只想吞食能吞的一切，而它们什么都能吞。若它们还会饮，那就更糟。
与它们打交道，要当心。

string.ID:
I am always tired, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
My sleep comes in fits and starts, and always with ghastly visions. Sometimes my rest must be coaxed along with medicine.

strings.string:
我总是困倦，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
我的睡眠断断续续，且总伴着可怖的幻象。有时须得用药，才能哄我安歇。

string.ID: You have prophetic visions in your sleep?

strings.string: 你睡梦中会有预知的幻象？

string.ID: I see. That seems difficult.

strings.string: 我明白了。这听来着实不易。
哦。

string.ID:
Mm-hmm.
{{emote|*Iseppa yawns.*}}

strings.string:
嗯嗯。
{{emote|*伊赛帕打了个哈欠。*}}

string.ID:
I am Iseppa, and she is me.
I've given thought to being someone else, but never enough to try.

strings.string:
我是伊赛帕，而她就是我。
我也想过做别人，却从未想到真去试的地步。

string.ID: I am contemplating the distinction between animal and rock. Why are they different? How much like a rock must an animal be when it ceases to be an animal?

strings.string: 我在思索动物与岩石的分别。它们何以不同？一只动物不再是动物之时，须得有多像一块岩石？

string.ID: I am considering the window of consciousness through which each of us views the universe. What happens to it when we die?

strings.string: 我在思索那扇意识之窗——我们每个人都透过它去看宇宙。人死之后，它又会怎样？

string.ID: I am taking inventory of my faculties, and looking for any that I might not previously have considered.

strings.string: 我在清点自己的各种官能，看有没有哪一样是我先前未曾想到的。

string.ID: I am considering the thought as a discrete object. I wish to determine whether I am able to think a single thought only, and to determine how to distinguish it from another thought in the same vein.

strings.string: 我在把思想当作一件离散的物来想。我想弄清，我是否只能想出一个单独的念头，又该如何把它与同类的另一个念头区分开来。

string.ID: I am considering the determination of goodness and badness in a thing, and how it is determined. The interaction between data and subjective evaluation, and the values that guide us that we cannot put to words.

strings.string: 我在思索一件事物之好坏是如何被断定的。数据与主观评判之间的交互，以及那些引导我们、却无法言说的价值。

string.ID: I am contemplating the Spindle's place in Qud, its position as a conceptual focal point. How much of what we know of the Spindle is the craft of those before us, carried forward?

strings.string: 我在思索纺锤在卡德的地位，它作为一个观念焦点的位置。我们所知的纺锤，有多少是前人的手笔，一代代传承至今？

string.ID: I am considering narrative inheritances. The stories we were told when our minds were more putty-like, the follies that shaped who we are, that shape the whole of Qud.

strings.string: 我在思索叙事的传承。那些在我们心智尚如软泥时听来的故事，那些塑造了我们的愚行，也塑造着整个卡德。

string.ID: Oh. It looks like you are sorting screws and fasteners.

strings.string: 哦。你好像在分拣螺丝和紧固件。

string.ID: Have you come to any conclusions?

strings.string: 你可有什么结论了？

string.ID: I shall leave you to it. Live and drink, contemplatrix.

strings.string: 我不打扰你了。且生且饮，沉思者。
愿意。

string.ID: But you're also doing the other thing.

strings.string: 可你同时也在做另一件事。

string.ID: I'll leave you to it.

strings.string: 我不打扰你了。

string.ID: Not yet, but that's not the point.

strings.string: 尚无结论，不过那并不要紧。

string.ID: Oh, I see.

strings.string: 哦，我明白了。

string.ID: I'll leave you to it, then.

strings.string: 那我就不打扰你了。

string.ID: Who are you? Get out of my work space!

strings.string: 你是谁？滚出我的工作间！

string.ID: Sorry! I'm going!

strings.string: 抱歉！我这就走！

string.ID: Innovation's sworn enemies have come knocking, =name=. Let us answer them.

strings.string: 革新的死敌已登门叩户，=name=。让我们迎击。

string.ID: Take care.

strings.string: 保重。

string.ID: =name=. Come in. Eat.

strings.string: =name=。进来。吃点东西。

string.ID: You seem more irritated than usual.

strings.string: 你似乎比平日更烦躁。

string.ID: About your workshop...

strings.string: 关于你的工坊……

string.ID:
Otho has forbidden me from requesting a sample of Klanq. I am to refrain from being puffed on, to cultivate my own!
Are we yet researchers? Is subject consent no longer adequate ethical rigor? Let Klanq puff on Dardi!

strings.string:
奥索禁止我向克朗克索取样本。我须得忍住不被它喷一身，好自己培养！
我们还算不算研究者？受试者同意，难道已不足以称作伦理上的严谨？让克朗克来喷达尔迪吧！

string.ID: Well, I should go. Live and drink.

strings.string: 嗯，我该走了。且生且饮。

string.ID: Death to all subjugators who dare face us.

strings.string: 凡敢与我们为敌的压迫者，一律处死。

string.ID: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我必须穿过食者之墓，进入明冥。

string.ID: About your workshop...

strings.string: 关于你的工坊……

string.ID: Oh? Oh! Do pick up the mopango recipe for bone babka while you're there, won't you? I must know how they make it so dense.

strings.string: 哦？哦！你去那儿时，务必替我带回莫潘戈做骨头巴布卡糕的配方，好不好？我非得弄明白，他们是怎么把它做得那样瓷实的。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Dardi addresses you without looking up from =pronouns.possessive= many workspaces, many of which billow smoke, steam, or some unknown miasma.*}}
Welcome to my laboratory, =name=. Rest and sustain =player.reflexive= before returning to your travels.

strings.string:
{{emote|*达尔迪没有抬头，便向你开口。=pronouns.possessive=的诸多工作台前，许多都正冒着烟、喷着汽，或是腾起某种不明的瘴气。*}}
欢迎来到我的实验室，=name=。先歇一歇，=player.reflexive=养足精神，再继续你的旅程。

string.ID: Do you know anything about Bethesda Susa?

strings.string: 你对毕士大-苏萨可有所知？

string.ID: What do you know about Omonporch and the self-appointed Earl?

strings.string: 关于奥蒙门廊和那位自封的伯爵，你知道些什么？

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Dardi?

strings.string: 达尔迪，你感觉到那阵隆隆声了吗？

string.ID: Have you ever met Pax Klanq?

strings.string: 你见过帕克斯·克朗克吗？

string.ID: That smell from the oven is... indescribable.

strings.string: 烤炉里飘出的那股气味……难以形容。

string.ID: What are you working on?

strings.string: 你在忙什么？

string.ID: Laboratory? You work in a kitchen.

strings.string: 实验室？你这明明是厨房。

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 且生且饮，庖厨修补匠。

string.ID:
Yes! I have braved its wharf in the past, to gather precious convalessence for my experiments.
Are you going? Dress warmly and mind the trolls.

strings.string:
是的！我从前闯过它的码头，去采集珍贵的愈元液，供我做实验。
你要去吗？穿暖些，当心巨魔。

string.ID: Did you call this kitchen your laboratory?

strings.string: 你管这厨房叫实验室？

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 且生且饮，庖厨修补匠。

string.ID:
Omonporch is a fine source of bananas, but I have little to say about self-appointed nobility.
Claimed authority has a heady aroma, but no broth beneath it. Let us simply appease Asphodel and leave xem to xyr fantasies.

strings.string:
奥蒙门廊是上好的香蕉产地，至于那自封的贵胄，我没什么可说。
自称的权威，香气扑鼻，汤底却空空如也。我们只管安抚阿斯福德尔，任其沉溺于幻想便是。

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 且生且饮，庖厨修补匠。

string.ID:
My air-puffed pastry experiment collapsed thanks to that disturbance.
Whoever is responsible will pay dearly.

strings.string:
我那充气酥饼的实验，被那阵震动弄塌了。
无论是谁干的，必将付出沉重代价。

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 且生且饮，庖厨修补匠。

string.ID:
I have visited the rainbow wood but once, and there I sampled an array of strange foods, one of which allowed me an unusual lens through which to view the world. It was nothing like I had ever experienced, and I imagined such wondrous recipes. I wrote them all down as best I could, of course.
Sadly, once I returned to my ordinary frame of reference, my scribblings proved impossible to read. So it goes.

strings.string:
我只去过虹林一次，在那里尝遍了各式怪异的食物，其中一样让我得了一副不寻常的镜片，借以观看世界。那是我从未有过的体验，我构想出种种奇妙的食谱，自然，也尽力全都记了下来。
可惜，等我回到寻常的参照系，我那些涂鸦便再也读不出来了。世事如此。

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 且生且饮，庖厨修补匠。

string.ID:
What you smell is Grit Gate's signature dish. The Porridge is a recipe passed down through generations of Barathrumites, and it is the food that inspired me to pursue my craft. Yes, outsiders quail at the intensity of the scent, for its flavor is as bold as its effects!
We use cuisine to channel lightning from our bodies! Other recipes may let us breathe fire, or learn the secrets of the Eaters. The Porridge is as precious a part of our legacy as the Barathrum Clock or the foaminator.

strings.string:
你闻到的，是砂砾门的招牌菜。这“粥”是巴拉斯鲁姆派世代相传的食谱，也是它启发我走上这门手艺。是的，外人闻到那股浓烈的气味便要畏缩，因为它的滋味与功效同样大胆！
我们靠饮食，引雷电出体！别的食谱或许能让我们喷火，或是习得食者的秘密。这“粥”之于我们的传承，与巴拉斯鲁姆钟、泡沫机一样珍贵。

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 且生且饮，庖厨修补匠。

string.ID:
Oh, it changes by the hour, sometimes the minute. Preserve this, observe that, add anything, taste everything.
But the starapple of my eye, the Spindle up which I cast my ambitious gaze... is edible vapor. Food that you eat, food that you breathe. Sadly, to date the most I have managed is an herbed saline suspension. Salty air, if you will.

strings.string:
哦，那每个钟点都在变，有时每一分钟都在变。这个要保存，那个要观察，什么都往里加，什么都要尝。
但我心头的星苹果，我雄心勃勃向其仰望的纺锤……是可食的蒸气。一种你既吃得、也吸得的食物。可惜，迄今为止，我至多做出一种加了香草的盐溶悬浮液。算是咸味的空气吧，你若愿意这么说。

string.ID: Vapor... and salt?

strings.string: 蒸气……与盐？

string.ID: Good luck with your experiments, then.

strings.string: 那就祝你实验顺利。

string.ID: Well, I should be going.

strings.string: 嗯，我该走了。

string.ID: Yes. The flavor, the breathability, all successful, but the barrier between flavor and food is in the calories, and they have yet eluded me. But it is only a matter of time. I am patient, and I am relentless.

strings.string: 是的。风味、可呼吸性，都已成功，可风味与食物之间的那道屏障在于热量，而它们至今仍躲着我。不过那只是时间问题。我有耐心，也不会放弃。

string.ID: Good luck, then.

strings.string: 那就祝你好运。

string.ID: I will leave you to it. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我不打扰你了。且生且饮。

string.ID:
I have no need for luck, but I appreciate your well-wishes nonetheless.
May your own endeavors drive you as mine drive me. Did you wish to speak of anything else?

strings.string:
我不需要运气，不过仍感谢你的美意。
愿你自己的事业驱策你，一如我的事业驱策我。你还想谈别的吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 且生且饮，庖厨修补匠。

string.ID: Kitchen? You think this a mere kitchen?

strings.string: 厨房？你以为这不过是个厨房？

string.ID: It certainly looks like a kitchen.

strings.string: 这看着确实像个厨房。

string.ID: No, of course it's a laboratory, I wasn't thinking.

strings.string: 不，当然是实验室，我刚才没多想。

string.ID: Why don't I see myself out?

strings.string: 我还是自己出去吧？

string.ID:
And I suppose the Stilt is a modest church, its great bazaar a junk sale?
Look about you. Every instrument you see is precision-calibrated, every tool handcrafted and built to last. In this room, sustenance and ingenuity come together to evolve cuisine itself, to shape not this culture alone but, over time, every culture. Is that kind of influence the product of a kitchen? Can a simple clay oven in the flower fields do what we do here? Has every kitchen an indelible influence over Qud?
{{emote|*He frowns.*}}
Should they? Should we not all?

strings.string:
依你的意思，高塔不过是座寒素的教堂，它那座大集市不过是旧货摊？
看看四周。你见到的每件器具都经精确校准，每样工具都是手工打造、经久耐用。在这间屋子里，滋养与巧思汇聚一处，使烹饪本身得以演进，所塑造的不止是这一种文化，久而久之，是每一种文化。厨房能有这样的影响吗？花田里一座简陋的泥炉，能做到我们在此所做的吗？每一间厨房，都对卡德有着不可磨灭的影响吗？
{{emote|*他皱起眉头。*}}
它们该有吗？我们不都该有吗？
是？
不吗？

string.ID: I'm lost.

strings.string: 我糊涂了。

string.ID: *mutter 'live and drink' while backing away*

strings.string: *一边低声咕哝“且生且饮”，一边往后退*

string.ID:
But perhaps you are right, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Think for a moment.
Every ingredient in the soup of collective knowledge is a valuable one, and who am I to elevate myself over more humble pioneers? But! All the more reason for us to regard cuisine (and by extension, culture itself) to be a scientific endeavor, an ongoing trial-and-error, a blending of what we know and what we don't know, calling upon reality itself to be our guide.
You are more insightful than I realized, =name=. Thank you for this discussion. Did you need aught else?

strings.string:
不过，或许你是对的，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你想一想。
集体知识这锅汤里，每一味材料都有其价值，我又凭什么抬高自己，压过那些更谦卑的先行者？但是！这愈发是我们将烹饪（乃至文化本身）视作科学事业的理由——一场不断试错的事业，将已知与未知相融，召唤现实本身来作我们的向导。
你比我以为的更有见地，=name=。多谢这番交谈。你还需要什么吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, food-tinkerer.

strings.string: 且生且饮，庖厨修补匠。

string.ID: I propose an accord, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=: You remove =player.reflexive= from my sight immediately, and I will refrain from asking that Ereshkigal reduce you to your component atoms.

strings.string: 我提议订立一份协约，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=：你即刻将=player.reflexive=从我眼前移开，我便不请埃列什基伽勒把你拆成原子。

string.ID: I'm going, I'm going.

strings.string: 我走，我走。

string.ID: Not like this. After all we've accomplished...

strings.string: 不该是这样的。我们明明已经成就了那么多……

string.ID: Don't lose hope.

strings.string: 别灰心。

string.ID: Ah. It's you again, returning from ever more unreturnable locales. Alive and come to bother the disagreeable urshiib.

strings.string: 啊。又是你，从越发回不来的去处归来。竟还活着，又来搅扰这个不讨喜的乌尔希卜。

string.ID: What do you think of Klanq's visit?

strings.string: 你对克朗克来访一事，有何看法？

string.ID: Can we talk, Aloysius?

strings.string: 我们能谈谈吗，阿洛伊修斯？

string.ID:
I did not consider that my life could be further upturned. Truly, I have learned much and I hate it all.
Once you lot reach the spindle's apex, perhaps you could be convinced to stay there? Or perhaps I could go in your stead.

strings.string:
我没想到，我的生活还能被再度颠覆。我确实学到了许多，且对此一概痛恨。
等你们这伙人登上纺锤之巅，或许可以说服你们留在那儿？或者，由我代你们去也行。

string.ID: We will miss you too, Aloysius. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我们也会想念你的，阿洛伊修斯。且生且饮。

string.ID:
I spent so long preparing for the eventuality that my home might be breached.
I was not ready. This sense of violation burns like electrocautery.

strings.string:
我耗费了那么久，预备着家园可能被攻破的那一天。
我却没有准备好。这种被侵犯的感觉，灼痛如电烙。

string.ID: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我必须穿过食者之墓，进入明冥。

string.ID: Can we talk, Aloysius?

strings.string: 我们能谈谈吗，阿洛伊修斯？

string.ID: Good. Shut the sarcophagus door behind you.

strings.string: 好。进去后把石棺的门在身后关严。

string.ID: Perhaps I will.

strings.string: 或许我会。

string.ID:
Of course it was only a matter of time before you came to speak to me.
I don't suppose I can convince you to let me tend to my duties in peace? I know nothing of interest to a wayfarer. Each of my days is like the others; I maintain and protect my children, and this is enough. If I desire conversation, there is Ereshkigal.

strings.string:
你迟早会来找我说话，这自然是意料中事。
我想，大概说服不了你让我安安静静料理职守吧？我没有什么值得一个远行者感兴趣的东西。我的每一天都与别的日子无异；我看护并守卫我的孩子们，这就够了。若我想找人说话，还有埃列什基伽勒。

string.ID: Do you know anything about Bethesda Susa?

strings.string: 你对毕士大-苏萨可有所知？

string.ID: What do you know about Omonporch and the self-appointed Earl?

strings.string: 关于奥蒙门廊和那位自封的伯爵，你知道些什么？

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Aloysius?

strings.string: 阿洛伊修斯，你感觉到那阵隆隆声了吗？

string.ID: Have you ever met Pax Klanq?

strings.string: 你见过帕克斯·克朗克吗？

string.ID: You have children?

strings.string: 你有孩子？

string.ID: You don't care for conversation?

strings.string: 你不喜欢交谈？

string.ID: Who is Ereshkigal?

strings.string: 埃列什基伽勒是谁？

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 愿你平安度日，阿洛伊修斯。且生且饮。

string.ID:
Bethesda Susa is a vibrant and thriving ecosystem in which we have no place. That said, I certainly would not complain if someone were to clear out its Mechanimist infestation.
Should you travel there, watch your step. The fronds of a lurking beth can rapidly exsanguinate fleshy creatures such as we.

strings.string:
毕士大-苏萨是个生机勃勃、欣欣向荣的生态，我们在其中没有立足之地。话虽如此，若有人把盘踞其中的机神教之患扫除干净，我断不会抱怨。
你若去那儿，当心脚下。潜伏的贝丝的叶片，能迅速放干你我这类血肉之躯的血。

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 愿你平安度日，阿洛伊修斯。且生且饮。

string.ID:
I know that Omonporch is a miserable, hot place and Asphodel is a self-important churl.
I don't even like bananas.

strings.string:
我只知道奥蒙门廊是个闷热而凄惨的地方，阿斯福德尔是个自命不凡的粗鄙之徒。
我连香蕉都不爱吃。

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 愿你平安度日，阿洛伊修斯。且生且饮。

string.ID: Yes, and I fear the worst. Hie to Ereshkigal. She will know what to do.

strings.string: 是的，我怕是最坏的情形。速去找埃列什基伽勒。她会知道怎么办。

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 愿你平安度日，阿洛伊修斯。且生且饮。

string.ID:
I have met Pax Klanq. I was puffed on.
Candidly, I prefer fungi edible and inert.

strings.string:
我见过帕克斯·克朗克。我被它喷了一身。
坦白说，我更爱可食且惰性的菌类。

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 愿你平安度日，阿洛伊修斯。且生且饮。

string.ID: My chromelings, my machines, my crops. I tend to them and they tend to me.

strings.string: 我的铬灵，我的机器，我的庄稼。我照料它们，它们也照料我。

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 愿你平安度日，阿洛伊修斯。且生且饮。

string.ID:
Speaking to other organics is as strenuous to me as any physical exercise.
My reclusiveness is not born of antipathy; I simply cannot converse as easily as you do and don't wish to learn how.

strings.string:
与其他有机生命交谈，于我而言，耗力不亚于任何体力活动。
我的离群索居并非出于憎恶；只是我不能像你们那样轻松地交谈，也不愿去学。

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 愿你平安度日，阿洛伊修斯。且生且饮。

string.ID:
Ereshkigal is the mainframe computer of Grit Gate. She keeps watch through the thin world, as she would put it, while we maintain her presence in the thick world.
I feel as though she and I understand one another.

strings.string:
埃列什基伽勒是砂砾门的主机。用她自己的话说，她透过薄界守望，而我们则在厚界维护她的存在。
我觉得，她与我彼此相知。

string.ID: Live and drink in peace, Aloysius.

strings.string: 愿你平安度日，阿洛伊修斯。且生且饮。

string.ID: =player.OffspringTerm=, who are you?

strings.string: =player.OffspringTerm=，你是谁？

string.ID: Stay safe, =name=. Please.

strings.string: 保重，=name=。拜托了。

string.ID: Live and drink, Hortensa.

strings.string: 且生且饮，霍腾萨。

string.ID:
=name=, you are back! I feared we would lose you in the Tomb, but you look better than well. Perhaps I should have had greater faith, or at least less worry.
Have you visited Barathrum's workshop, by the by? Klanq and Q Girl await you there.

strings.string:
=name=，你回来了！我原担心要在墓中失去你，可你看起来岂止是好。或许我该更有信心，至少少些忧虑。
对了，你去过巴拉斯鲁姆的工坊没有？克朗克和Q女孩在那里等你。

string.ID: I have.

strings.string: 去过了。

string.ID: Not yet.

strings.string: 还没有。

string.ID: Hie there now. Being tardy with Klanq carries risk, not so much from its offense as from its idle curiosity.

strings.string: 现在就去。对克朗克迟到是有风险的，倒不在于它会动怒，而在于它那闲来无事的好奇心。

string.ID: Very well. Live and drink.

strings.string: 好吧。且生且饮。

string.ID: I am further relieved to know of another perspective looking upon this work. Klanq's presence here is vital, but it discomfits me: I cannot help but consider the introduction of chaos to an already chaotic endeavor to be a... conflagratory strategy.

strings.string: 得知又多了一双眼睛注视着这项工作，我更觉宽慰。克朗克在此至关重要，却也让我不安：我总忍不住觉得，把混乱引入一项本就混乱的事业，是一种……引火烧身的策略。

string.ID: I will exercise my best judgement. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我会尽力判断。且生且饮。

string.ID: I drink in the sight of you, cub. Thank you for keeping safe.

strings.string: 我看着你，如饮甘泉，孩子。谢谢你平安无恙。

string.ID: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我必须穿过食者之墓，进入明冥。

string.ID: Drink deeply of life, Hortensa. Let's talk.

strings.string: 痛饮生命吧，霍腾萨。我们聊聊。

string.ID: You too. Live and drink.

strings.string: 你也是。且生且饮。

string.ID:
... I do not like this.
I know you will go. Please take care where you dig; mopango wanderers say the hot blood of Eater artifice yet runs in the guts of that place.

strings.string:
……我不喜欢这样。
我知道你会去的。挖掘时请多加小心；莫潘戈的漫游者说，食者巧工的滚烫热血，至今仍在那地方的肠腹中流淌。

string.ID: I thank you.

strings.string: 多谢你。

string.ID: Drink deeply of life, =player.offspringTerm=. Are you finding your way?

strings.string: 痛饮生命吧，=player.offspringTerm=。你可找到自己的路了？

string.ID:
There are pools of convalessence there. You see, when cryogenic mist condenses, it forms a cool, luminous liquid that's restorative if you're able to bathe in it.
Oh! And in one of the ruined wards, the Alchemist keeps their shop. Who's the Alchemist, you ask? A sort of enigmatic figure -- amateur liquid-tinker, poet, merchant. Their methods aren't scientific, but they are useful if you're seeking a specific kind of liquid. Just be careful around them, =name=.

strings.string:
那里有一汪汪愈元液。你瞧，低温雾气凝结时，会化成一种清凉而发光的液体，若能浸身其中，便有复元之效。
哦！还有，在某座破败的病区里，炼金术士开着他们的铺子。你问炼金术士是谁？是个有些神秘的人物——业余的液体修补匠、诗人、商贩。他们的法子算不上科学，但你若要找某一类特定的液体，倒是管用。只是在他们面前要小心，=name=。

string.ID:

Years. Decades on decades. Centuries, perhaps. Most of these wet-earred cubs were merely sketches in their mothers' dreambooks when I arrived to study under Barathrum. We knew so little then, know so little now.

strings.string:
{{emote|*霍腾萨轻声笑了。*}}
许多年。一个又一个十年。或许有几个世纪了。我来此拜巴拉斯鲁姆为师时，这些乳臭未干的小崽儿大多还只是他们母亲梦书里的草稿。那时我们所知甚少，如今也所知甚少。

string.ID: Could you tell me about the other Barathrumites?

strings.string: 你能给我讲讲其他的巴拉斯鲁姆派众人吗？

string.ID: Are you a liquid-tinker?

strings.string: 你是液体修补匠吗？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Hortensa chuckles.*}}
You are sharp, =name=. In a way that's what I am. But liquids are more willful than scrap. I can't solder them together; they would run away, hide in the shale cracks, slowly come apart and disappear. I moreso think of myself as a wisewoman in dialogue with them -- I manage their moods and phases. My notebooks are full of their quirks and caprices. It's a wonder, isn't it, how at just the right temperature and pressure the continuity of matter is smashed apart? How the gaseous butterfly flits out of the dense worm?

strings.string:
{{emote|*霍腾萨轻声笑了。*}}
你很敏锐，=name=。某种意义上，我正是如此。可液体比废料更有主见。我没法把它们焊在一起；它们会跑掉，躲进页岩的裂缝，慢慢散开，消失不见。我更愿把自己看作与它们对话的智妇——调理它们的情绪与相态。我的笔记簿里满是它们的怪癖与任性。你说奇不奇妙，恰在合宜的温度与压力下，物质的连续性便被击得粉碎？气态的蝴蝶，便从稠密的蠕虫中翩然飞出？

string.ID: After supper I like to retreat to the library, take a storybook off the shelves, flop down on the chairbear, and lose myself in another world. Many of these worlds feature palaces, markets, gardens, ships. Many of those places have bells. When they do, I always think of Mafeo. More than anyone else, Mafeo could be a character in the bright world of a story, where this dusty place is itself confined to a mere storybook.

strings.string: 晚餐后，我爱退进藏书室，从书架上取下一本故事书，往椅熊上一躺，沉入另一个世界。这些世界里，许多都有宫殿、集市、花园、船舶。那些地方，许多都有钟。每逢有钟，我总想起马费奥。比起任何人，马费奥更像是明亮的故事世界里的一个角色，而这个尘土漫漫的地方，倒像是困在一本小小的故事书里。

strings.string: 我该躲进藏书室吗？我想那是明智之举。

string.ID: Stay safe, Shem.

strings.string: 多加小心，舍姆。

string.ID: Approach. Be easy. You are my herefriend, my nowfriend.

strings.string: 过来。放松些。你是我的此处之友，我的当下之友。

string.ID: Would you like to read me a story?

strings.string: 你愿意给我读个故事吗？

string.ID: I know of so many other ways to be.

strings.string: 我晓得许许多多别样的存在之道。

string.ID: Where does it end?

strings.string: 终点在何处？

string.ID: I live, but do I drink?

strings.string: 我活着，可我饮了吗？

string.ID: Would you like to eat vapor?

strings.string: 你想尝尝蒸气吗？

string.ID: Quetzal, I say.

strings.string: 我说，魁札尔。

string.ID: {{emote|*Shem nods.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*舍姆点了点头。*}}

string.ID: The gaseous butterfly flits out of the dense worm.

strings.string: 气态的蝴蝶自稠密的蠕虫中翩然飞出。

string.ID: I am sharp. I am handy.

strings.string: 我锋利。我趁手。

string.ID: {{emote|*Shem yawns.*}} I am yawning.

strings.string: {{emote|*舍姆打了个哈欠。*}}我在打哈欠。

string.ID: 'Immaculate Chrome' is my favorite.

strings.string: “无瑕铬”是我的最爱。

string.ID: I'm glad you are safe, Shem.

strings.string: 你平安，我很欣慰，舍姆。

string.ID: What do you think of Klanq's visit?

strings.string: 你对克朗克来访一事，有何看法？

string.ID: You're a chromeling... that speaks? Can you understand me?

strings.string: 你是个会说话的……铬灵？你能听懂我的话吗？

string.ID: Why are you called Shem -1?

strings.string: 你为何叫舍姆-1？

string.ID: I am your friend, Shem.

strings.string: 我是你的朋友，舍姆。

string.ID: Live and... remain ever rustless.

strings.string: 且生且饮，且永不生锈。

string.ID: I am glad you are safe, =name=.

strings.string: 你平安，我很欣慰，=name=。

string.ID: I wonder if the distributed consciousness of a fungal entity is similar to that of a distributed machine mind. I shall ask Father when he is not so busy.

strings.string: 我在想，菌类生灵的分布式意识，是否与分布式机器心智相仿。待父亲不那么忙时，我再去问他。

string.ID: Is... is this a question trick? I suppose I cannot know what you intend. Can I understand you?

strings.string: 这……这是个陷阱问题吗？我想我无从知晓你的用意。我能听懂你吗？

string.ID: I just meant to ask if you're able to communicate. It seems so.

strings.string: 我不过是想问你能不能交流。看来是能的。

string.ID: What kind words. It seems so with you, too.

strings.string: 好暖心的话。看来你也能。

string.ID:
Would you like to hear? When I was first put together by Father and friends, I was Shem 2, the second iteration of the make-me project.
As I came along, scampered through the halls, listened to the stories Neek read me, climbed onto Sparafucile's workbench to have my screws replaced, I realized I was not what I could be. And so I downgraded myself to Shem 1.
That has happened three times.

strings.string:
你愿意听吗？当初父亲与诸位友人把我拼合起来时，我是舍姆2，即“造我计划”的第二个迭代。
后来我渐渐长成，在廊厅间蹦跳，听尼克给我读故事，爬上斯帕拉富奇莱的工作台换螺钉，才发觉自己并非所能成之模样。于是我把自己降格为舍姆1。
这样的事已发生三回了。

string.ID: Are you worried that you're getting further away from your ideal self?

strings.string: 你是否担心自己离理想中的自我越来越远？

string.ID: It's unclear to me that I should be.

strings.string: 我并不明白自己为何该担心。

string.ID: I am your friend, =name=.

strings.string: 我是你的朋友，=name=。

string.ID: Who are you? What? Please, do not disturb me.

strings.string: 你是谁？什么事？请不要打扰我。

string.ID:
The Templar are assaulting the enclave? Oh dear, dear...
May our guns' lasers shine with the light of the Kasaphescence.

strings.string:
圣殿骑士在攻打据点？哎呀，哎呀……
愿我们枪炮的激光，闪耀着圣化现的光辉。

string.ID: I must go.

strings.string: 我得走了。

string.ID:
Why, =name=, Brightsheol treated you well. There is a new gravity about you; your proverbial boots ring louder in the Annals with each step.
I imagine you're off to Teach's study? They're already at work down there.

strings.string:
哎呀，=name=，明冥待你不薄。你身上添了一种新的分量；你那出了名的靴声，每踏一步，在《编年史》里便更响一分。
我猜你是要去教习的书房吧？他们已在下头忙开了。

string.ID: What do you think of Klanq's presence?

strings.string: 你对克朗克在此驻留，作何看法？

string.ID: Light shine through you, Jacobo. Let's talk.

strings.string: 愿光穿透你，雅各博。我们聊聊吧。

string.ID:
I admit a burning curiosity to see the joined imagination of our Q Girl and Pax Klanq, and no doubt yours as well. Watching such a creation burgeon from empty space to fullness of being would be a joyful entry in the chronicles of my life, but...
Too many fingers tangle in the honeypot, as my cubhood mentor would tell me.

strings.string:
我坦白，极想一睹我们的Q女孩与帕克斯·克朗克，还有无疑也有你，三方想象合成的造物。眼看这等创造从虚空长至圆满，必是我生平记事中一桩欢喜的条目，只是……
蜜罐里伸进的手指太多了，我幼年时的导师常这样告诫我。

string.ID: So they do. Live and drink, Jacobo.

strings.string: 确是如此。且生且饮，雅各博。

string.ID:
Never before had the Templar broken so far through our defenses. We live a new reality now, one harder to weather.
Is there anything you need, =name=?

strings.string:
圣殿骑士从未攻破我们的防线至此。我们如今活在一种更难熬的新现实里。
你可有什么需要，=name=？

string.ID: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我必须穿过食者之墓，进入明冥。

string.ID: Light shine through you, Jacobo. Let's talk.

strings.string: 愿光穿透你，雅各博。我们聊聊吧。

string.ID: No. Live and drink.

strings.string: 没有。且生且饮。

string.ID:
My quills prickle with unease to hear you say such things.
Be certain to visit the village of Ezra. The Daughter of Exile who lives there is as good a tinker as any I know, and she always has surplus she's willing to sell.

strings.string:
听你说这些，我的刺毛不禁发紧。
务必去以斯拉村看看。住在那里的流亡之女，是我所识的修补匠中的佼佼者，她手头总有余货肯卖。

string.ID: I thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 多谢。且生且饮。

string.ID: Light shine through you, friend.

strings.string: 愿光穿透你，朋友。

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Jacobo?

strings.string: 你可感到那阵隆隆声了吗，雅各博？

string.ID: Jacobo, do you have advice for entering Bethesda Susa?

strings.string: 雅各博，你对进入毕士大-苏萨有何建议？

string.ID: Is that... music... coming from your loudspeaker? It sounds like a bell echoing in the void backward through time.

strings.string: 你的扩音器里传出的……是音乐吗？ 听来像一口钟的回响，逆着时间在虚空中荡去。

string.ID: That chrome orb earring you're wearing. What's the meaning of it?

strings.string: 你戴的那只铬球耳环，有什么寓意？

string.ID: You have so many data disks.

strings.string: 你有好多数据盘。

string.ID: What can you tell me about Grit Gate?

strings.string: 关于砂砾门，你能告诉我什么？

string.ID: The Temple of the Rock is cut off from the wider world, and I hear the Mechanimist colonists no longer recognize High Priest Eschelstadt. That said, if you are favored by the Mechanimists, if you are welcome in their holy places, then I've no doubt that Phinae Hoshaiah will grant you peaceful entry.

strings.string: 磐石圣殿与外界隔绝，我听说机神教的殖民者已不再承认大祭司埃舍尔施塔特。话虽如此，倘若你得机神教垂青，在他们的圣所受欢迎，那么我毫不怀疑菲奈·何沙雅会允你平安入内。

string.ID: Is that... music... coming from your loudspeaker? It sounds like a bell echoing in the void backward through time.

strings.string: 关于砂砾门，你能告诉我什么？

string.ID: Yea! So you like it? Sheba Hag and I composed it on a wavelathe. We made a series of songs about the birth and life of the Kasaphescence. Together we call them "Spun on the Cosmic Loom".

strings.string: 哎！你喜欢吗？我和舍芭·哈格在波纹车床上谱的。我们作了一组歌，咏圣化现的诞生与生平，合称《纺于宇宙织机》。

string.ID: Oh, Sheba Hagadias. She's the librarian at the cathedral of the Six Day Stilt. My water-sister and cohort in chrome.

strings.string: 噢，舍芭·哈加迪亚斯。她是六日高塔大教堂的藏书官。我的水姊妹，铬道上的同伴。

string.ID:
Beauty manifest, whose chromium shoals are Awe itself. In my belief system, She's the being from whom all metal was birthed, out in the ever-void. There are pieces of Her in every chrome belfry and every machine. Even bits of Her in our own blood.
For me, Her essence extends beyond mere metal. Anything that's ordered, She infuses: a poem, a mathematical proof, a clean workspace... so definitely not Q Girl's.

strings.string:
显现之美，其铬质浅滩即是敬畏本身。依我的信仰，她是万金之母，在永恒的虚空之外生出一切金属。每座铬质钟楼、每台机器里都有她的碎片，连我们自己的血中也有一丝她的踪影。
于我而言，她的本质不止于金属。凡有秩序之物，她皆灌注其中：一首诗、一道数学证明、一间整洁的工作间……当然，Q女孩的不算。

strings.string: 算是吧。我属于只尊圣化现为神的一支。我们认为银辉诸父乃尘世中人：于教门初史至为要紧，却非神明。

strings.string: 噢，那是银色圆球。是对圣化现虔信的标记。

string.ID:
Don't I know it. I've had to invent eight separate systems of organization to manage them all. At the moment I'm trying out a new one, Harmonices Spiralis. Spiral towers with heights increasing according to the harmonic series of numbers. It's... fine.
The problem is I'm always inscribing more disks. New contraptions. Reverse-engineered artifacts. It's a good problem to have, I suppose.
Take a look. See if any interest you.

strings.string:
可不是嘛。我不得不发明八套不同的整理系统来管理它们。眼下我在试一套新的，《螺旋和声》：螺旋塔，塔高依数列的调和级数递增。还……凑合吧。
问题是我总在刻录更多盘。新奇装置、逆向还原的遗物。这算是个甜蜜的烦恼吧，我想。
去瞧瞧吧，看有没有你感兴趣的。

string.ID:
We're a vibrant community here. A circle of monks mapping the outer lattices and raising viaducts where we need to.
We remain secluded to protect ourselves. Otho and Barathrum insist on it. They are wise, and I defer to them. My collaboration with Sheba Hag does cause them worry, but they tolerate it, bless their hearts.

strings.string:
我们这儿是个生气勃勃的共同体。一圈僧侣测绘外层格网，需要之处便架起高架桥。
我们深居简出以自保，奥索与巴拉斯鲁姆坚持如此。他们睿智，我也听从。我与舍芭·哈格的合作确让他们担忧，但他们容忍了，真是好心肠。
